/-- Unsigned branch refinement on `x ≤ c`. -/
theorem range_refine_ule {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : x ≤ c) :
    lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ bvMin hi c :=
  ⟨hlo, le_bvMin hhi hc⟩

/-- Unsigned branch refinement on `c ≤ x`. -/
theorem range_refine_uge {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : c ≤ x) :
    bvMax lo c ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi :=
  ⟨bvMax_le hlo hc, hhi⟩

/-- Unsigned branch refinement on strict `x < c`. -/
theorem range_refine_ult {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : x < c) :
    lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ bvMin hi (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1) := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : x.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ x.isLt)
    have hc0 : c.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ c.isLt)
    have hlt : x.toNat < c.toNat := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) := by
      rw [nat_pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
        (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos w') (nat_two_pow_pos w'))
    have h1le : BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1 ≤ c := by
      change (BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1).toNat ≤ c.toNat
      rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat, nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt]
      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le x.toNat) hc
    have hxc : x ≤ c - BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1 := by
      change x.toNat ≤ (c - BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1).toNat
      rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_sub_of_le h1le, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
        nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt]
      exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hc
    exact ⟨hlo, le_bvMin hhi hxc⟩

/-- Unsigned branch refinement on strict `c < x`. -/
theorem range_refine_ugt {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : lo ≤ x) (hhi : x ≤ hi) (hc : c < x) :
    bvMax lo (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : x.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ x.isLt)
    have hc0 : c.toNat = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ c.isLt)
    have hlt : c.toNat < x.toNat := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) := by
      rw [nat_pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
        (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos w') (nat_two_pow_pos w'))
    have hc1_le : c.toNat + 1 ≤ x.toNat := hc
    have hc1_lt : c.toNat + 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hc1_le x.isLt
    have hcx : c + BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1 ≤ x := by
      change (c + BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1).toNat ≤ x.toNat
      rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_add, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
        nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt, nat_mod_eq_of_lt hc1_lt]
      exact hc1_le
    exact ⟨bvMax_le hlo hcx, hhi⟩

/-- Signed interval intersection soundness. -/
theorem signed_range_intersect_sound {w : Nat} {lo₁ hi₁ lo₂ hi₂ x : BitVec w}
    (h1 : sle lo₁ x ∧ sle x hi₁) (h2 : sle lo₂ x ∧ sle x hi₂) :
    sle (sbvMax lo₁ lo₂) x ∧ sle x (sbvMin hi₁ hi₂) :=
  ⟨sbvMax_sle h1.1 h2.1, sle_sbvMin h1.2 h2.2⟩

/-- Signed branch refinement on `sle x c`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_sle {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : sle x c) :
    sle lo x ∧ sle x (sbvMin hi c) :=
  ⟨hlo, sle_sbvMin hhi hc⟩

/-- Signed branch refinement on `sle c x`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_sge {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : sle c x) :
    sle (sbvMax lo c) x ∧ sle x hi :=
  ⟨sbvMax_sle hlo hc, hhi⟩

private theorem signedKey_sub_one {w : Nat} (hw : 0 < w) {c : BitVec w}
    (hpos : 0 < signedKey c) :
    signedKey (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1) = signedKey c - 1 := by
  have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 w := by
    rw [nat_two_pow_split hw]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
      (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)) (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)))
  have hmod_c :
      Nat.mod ((c - BitVec.ofNat w 1).toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) (Nat.pow 2 w) =
        Nat.mod ((signedKey c - 1) + Nat.pow 2 w) (Nat.pow 2 w) := by
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_sub, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
      nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt, nat_add_mod_cancel_left]
    have hkey := signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw c
    have hrearr :
        (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1) =
          (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + (c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) :=
      Nat.add_assoc _ _ _
    rw [hrearr, ← nat_add_mod_cancel_right (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) _ (Nat.pow 2 w),
      ← hkey]
    have hstep :
        (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + signedKey c = (signedKey c - 1) + Nat.pow 2 w := by
      have hsc : signedKey c = 1 + (signedKey c - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_comm 1 (signedKey c - 1)]
        exact Eq.symm (Nat.sub_add_cancel hpos)
      have h1 := congrArg (fun z => (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) + z) hsc
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc (Nat.pow 2 w - 1) 1 (signedKey c - 1),
        Nat.sub_add_cancel (nat_two_pow_pos w),
        Nat.add_comm (Nat.pow 2 w) (signedKey c - 1)] at h1
      exact h1
    rw [hstep]
  rw [signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1), hmod_c,
    Nat.add_comm (signedKey c - 1) (Nat.pow 2 w), nat_add_mod_left]
  exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ 1) (signedKey_lt c))

private theorem signedKey_add_one {w : Nat} (hw : 0 < w) {c : BitVec w}
    (hlt : signedKey c + 1 < Nat.pow 2 w) :
    signedKey (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1) = signedKey c + 1 := by
  have h1lt : 1 < Nat.pow 2 w := by
    rw [nat_two_pow_split hw]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self 1)
      (Nat.add_le_add (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)) (nat_two_pow_pos (w - 1)))
  rw [signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1),
    Anneal.BitVec.toNat_add, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat,
    nat_mod_eq_of_lt h1lt, nat_add_mod_cancel_left]
  have hrearr :
      c.toNat + 1 + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1) = (c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) + 1 :=
    Nat.add_right_comm c.toNat 1 (Nat.pow 2 (w - 1))
  rw [hrearr, ← nat_add_mod_cancel_left (c.toNat + Nat.pow 2 (w - 1)) 1 (Nat.pow 2 w),
    ← signedKey_eq_mod_add_half hw c]
  exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt hlt

/-- Signed branch refinement on strict `slt x c`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_slt {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : slt x c) :
    sle lo x ∧ sle x (sbvMin hi (c - BitVec.ofNat w 1)) := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : signedKey x = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt x))
    have hc0 : signedKey c = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt c))
    have hlt : signedKey x < signedKey c := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have hw : 0 < w' + 1 := Nat.zero_lt_succ w'
    have hc_pos : 0 < signedKey c := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hc
    have hxc : sle x (c - BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1) := by
      unfold sle
      rw [signedKey_sub_one hw hc_pos]
      exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hc
    exact ⟨hlo, sle_sbvMin hhi hxc⟩

/-- Signed branch refinement on strict `slt c x`. -/
theorem signed_range_refine_sgt {w : Nat} {lo hi x c : BitVec w}
    (hlo : sle lo x) (hhi : sle x hi) (hc : slt c x) :
    sle (sbvMax lo (c + BitVec.ofNat w 1)) x ∧ sle x hi := by
  cases w with
  | zero =>
    have hx0 : signedKey x = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt x))
    have hc0 : signedKey c = 0 :=
      Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (signedKey_lt c))
    have hlt : signedKey c < signedKey x := hc
    rw [hx0, hc0] at hlt
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hlt)
  | succ w' =>
    have hw : 0 < w' + 1 := Nat.zero_lt_succ w'
    have hc1_le : signedKey c + 1 ≤ signedKey x := hc
    have hc1_lt : signedKey c + 1 < Nat.pow 2 (w' + 1) :=
      Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hc1_le (signedKey_lt x)
    have hcx : sle (c + BitVec.ofNat (w' + 1) 1) x := by
      unfold sle
      rw [signedKey_add_one hw hc1_lt]
      exact hc1_le
    exact ⟨sbvMax_sle hlo hcx, hhi⟩

/-! ## Part 4: Bitfield Extraction and Byte-Swap (`bswap16`/`32`/`64`) -/

/-- Extract a `len`-bit field starting at bit offset `lo` from `x : BitVec w`.
-/
@[expose] def extractBits {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (lo len : Nat) : BitVec len :=
  Anneal.BitVec.setWidth len (Anneal.BitVec.ushr x lo)

/-- Exact `getLsbD` characterization of `extractBits x lo len`. -/
@[simp] theorem getLsbD_extractBits {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w)
    (lo len i : Nat) :
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (extractBits x lo len) i =
      (decide (i < len) && Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (i + lo)) := by
  unfold extractBits
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ushr]

/-- Exact `testBit` characterization of `extractBits x lo len`. -/
theorem testBit_extractBits {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (lo len i : Nat) :
    (extractBits x lo len).toNat.testBit i =
      (decide (i < len) && x.toNat.testBit (i + lo)) :=
  getLsbD_extractBits x lo len i

/-- Extracting a zero-width bitfield always yields `0#0`. -/
@[simp] theorem extractBits_zero_width {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (lo : Nat) :
    extractBits x lo 0 = BitVec.ofNat 0 0 := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero i hi)

/-- `extractBits` distributes over bitwise OR. -/
theorem extractBits_or {w : Nat} (x y : BitVec w) (lo len : Nat) :
    extractBits (Anneal.BitVec.or x y) lo len =
      Anneal.BitVec.or (extractBits x lo len) (extractBits y lo len) := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  rw [getLsbD_extractBits, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or, getLsbD_extractBits, getLsbD_extractBits,
    decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and, Bool.true_and, Bool.true_and]

/-- Extracting a field placed at bit offset `lo` (`lo + len ≤ w`) recovers
the original field exactly. -/
theorem extractBits_shl_setWidth {w len : Nat} (a : BitVec len) {lo : Nat}
    (hfit : lo + len ≤ w) :
    extractBits (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w a) lo) lo len =
      a := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  have hilo_lt : i + lo < w := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm i lo]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left hi lo) hfit
  rw [getLsbD_extractBits, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, decide_eq_true hilo_lt, Bool.true_and,
    decide_eq_true (Nat.le_add_left lo i), Bool.true_and,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth,
    decide_eq_true (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left len lo) hfit)),
    Bool.true_and]

private theorem extractBits_shl_setWidth_disjoint {w len₁ len₂ : Nat}
    (b : BitVec len₂) {lo₁ lo₂ : Nat}
    (hdisj : lo₁ + len₁ ≤ lo₂ ∨ lo₂ + len₂ ≤ lo₁) :
    extractBits (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w b) lo₂) lo₁ len₁ =
      BitVec.ofNat len₁ 0 := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  rw [getLsbD_extractBits, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_zero]
  cases hdisj with
  | inl hleft =>
    have hlt : i + lo₁ < lo₂ := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm i lo₁]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add_left hi lo₁) hleft
    rw [decide_eq_false (Nat.not_le_of_gt hlt), Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false]
  | inr hright =>
    have hge : len₂ ≤ i + lo₁ - lo₂ := by
      have h1 : lo₂ + len₂ ≤ i + lo₁ :=
        Nat.le_trans hright (Nat.le_add_left lo₁ i)
      have h2 : len₂ + lo₂ ≤ (i + lo₁ - lo₂) + lo₂ := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right lo₂ len₂) h1),
          Nat.add_comm len₂ lo₂]
        exact h1
      exact Nat.le_of_add_le_add_right h2
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge b hge,
      Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]

/-- Extracting two non-overlapping bitfields packed with bitwise OR recovers
both fields cleanly. -/
theorem extractBits_or_disjoint {w len₁ len₂ : Nat}
    (a : BitVec len₁) (b : BitVec len₂) {lo₁ lo₂ : Nat}
    (hfit₁ : lo₁ + len₁ ≤ w) (hfit₂ : lo₂ + len₂ ≤ w)
    (hdisj : lo₁ + len₁ ≤ lo₂ ∨ lo₂ + len₂ ≤ lo₁) :
    let packed := Anneal.BitVec.or
      (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w a) lo₁)
      (Anneal.BitVec.shl (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w b) lo₂)
    extractBits packed lo₁ len₁ = a ∧ extractBits packed lo₂ len₂ = b := by
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · rw [extractBits_or, extractBits_shl_setWidth a hfit₁,
      extractBits_shl_setWidth_disjoint b hdisj, Anneal.BitVec.or_zero]
  · rw [extractBits_or, extractBits_shl_setWidth_disjoint a (Or.symm hdisj),
      extractBits_shl_setWidth b hfit₂, Anneal.BitVec.zero_or]

/-- Exact soundness of tnum bitfield extraction (`extractBits`). -/
theorem tnum_extractBits_sound {w : Nat} {m x val : BitVec w}
    (lo len : Nat) (h : Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq m x val) :
    Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq (extractBits m lo len) (extractBits x lo len)
      (extractBits val lo len) :=
  tnum_setWidth_sound len (Anneal.BitVec.tnum_ushr_sound lo h)

/-- Move byte `src` (bits `8 * src .. 8 * src + 7`) of `x` into byte position
`dst` (bits `8 * dst .. 8 * dst + 7`). -/
@[expose] def moveByte {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (src dst : Nat) : BitVec w :=
  Anneal.BitVec.shl
    (Anneal.BitVec.setWidth w (extractBits x (8 * src) 8))
    (8 * dst)

private theorem getLsbD_moveByte {w : Nat} (x : BitVec w) (src dst i : Nat)
    (hi : i < w) :
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (moveByte x src dst) i =
      (decide (Nat.div i 8 = dst) &&
        Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * src)) := by
  unfold moveByte
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, getLsbD_extractBits]
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge (Nat.div i 8) dst with
  | inl hlt =>
    have hne : ¬ (Nat.div i 8 = dst) := Nat.ne_of_lt hlt
    have hi_lt : i < 8 * dst := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm 8 dst]
      exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos).1 hlt
    rw [decide_eq_false hne, decide_eq_false (Nat.not_le_of_gt hi_lt),
      Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and]
  | inr hge =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge dst (Nat.div i 8) with
    | inl hgt =>
      have hne : ¬ (Nat.div i 8 = dst) := Nat.ne_of_gt hgt
      have hdst1_le : dst + 1 ≤ Nat.div i 8 := hgt
      have hmul_le : 8 * dst + 8 ≤ i := by
        have h1 : (dst + 1) * 8 ≤ i := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le h8pos).1 hdst1_le
        rw [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_comm dst 8] at h1
        exact h1
      have hsub_ge : 8 ≤ i - 8 * dst := by
        have h1 : 8 + 8 * dst ≤ (i - 8 * dst) + 8 * dst := by
          rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right (8 * dst) 8) hmul_le),
            Nat.add_comm 8 (8 * dst)]
          exact hmul_le
        exact Nat.le_of_add_le_add_right h1
      rw [decide_eq_false hne, Bool.false_and,
        decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hsub_ge),
        Bool.false_and, Bool.and_false, Bool.and_false]
    | inr hle =>
      have heq : Nat.div i 8 = dst := Nat.le_antisymm hle hge
      have hi_decomp : 8 * dst + Nat.mod i 8 = i := by
        rw [← heq]
        exact nat_div_add_mod i 8
      have h8dst_le : 8 * dst ≤ i := by
        rw [← hi_decomp]
        exact Nat.le_add_right (8 * dst) (Nat.mod i 8)
      have hsub_eq : i - 8 * dst = Nat.mod i 8 := by
        have h1 := congrArg (fun z => z - 8 * dst) (Eq.symm hi_decomp)
        rw [Nat.add_comm (8 * dst) (Nat.mod i 8), Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
        exact h1
      have hmod_lt : Nat.mod i 8 < 8 := nat_mod_lt i h8pos
      have hmod_lt_w : Nat.mod i 8 < w :=
        Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mod_le i 8) hi
      rw [decide_eq_true heq, Bool.true_and, decide_eq_true h8dst_le,
        Bool.true_and, hsub_eq, decide_eq_true hmod_lt_w, Bool.true_and,
        decide_eq_true hmod_lt, Bool.true_and]

/-- Build the low `k` destination bytes of byte-reversed `x : BitVec (8 * n)`
via structural `@Nat.rec`. -/
@[expose] def bswapBytesAux {n : Nat} (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (k : Nat) : BitVec (8 * n) :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => BitVec (8 * n))
    (BitVec.ofNat (8 * n) 0)
    (fun j acc => Anneal.BitVec.or acc (moveByte x (n - 1 - j) j))
    k

private theorem bswapBytesAux_succ {n : Nat} (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (k : Nat) :
    bswapBytesAux x (k + 1) =
      Anneal.BitVec.or (bswapBytesAux x k) (moveByte x (n - 1 - k) k) :=
  rfl

private theorem getLsbD_bswapBytesAux {n : Nat} (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (k : Nat) :
    ∀ i, i < 8 * n →
      Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (bswapBytesAux x k) i =
        (decide (Nat.div i 8 < k) &&
          Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8))) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro i _
    change Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (BitVec.ofNat (8 * n) 0) i = _
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_zero, decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_zero _),
      Bool.false_and]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro i hi
    rw [bswapBytesAux_succ, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or, ih i hi,
      getLsbD_moveByte x (n - 1 - k) k i hi]
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge (Nat.div i 8) k with
    | inl hlt =>
      rw [decide_eq_true hlt, decide_eq_true (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hlt),
        decide_eq_false (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt), Bool.true_and,
        Bool.false_and, Bool.or_false]
    | inr hge =>
      cases Nat.lt_or_ge k (Nat.div i 8) with
      | inl hgt =>
        rw [decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge),
          decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hgt),
          decide_eq_false (Nat.ne_of_gt hgt), Bool.false_and, Bool.false_and,
          Bool.false_or]
      | inr hle =>
        have heq : Nat.div i 8 = k := Nat.le_antisymm hle hge
        rw [heq, decide_eq_false (Nat.lt_irrefl k),
          decide_eq_true (Nat.lt_succ_self k), decide_eq_true rfl,
          Bool.false_and, Bool.true_and, Bool.false_or]

/-- Reverse the `n` bytes of a `(8 * n)`-bit bitvector. -/
@[expose] def bswapBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (8 * n)) : BitVec (8 * n) :=
  bswapBytesAux x n

/-- Exact `getLsbD` characterization of `bswapBytes n x`. -/
@[simp] theorem getLsbD_bswapBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (8 * n)) (i : Nat) :
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (bswapBytes n x) i =
      (decide (i < 8 * n) &&
        Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x (Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8))) := by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge i (8 * n) with
  | inr hge =>
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge _ hge,
      decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hge), Bool.false_and]
  | inl hlt =>
    have hdiv_lt : Nat.div i 8 < n := by
      rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by decide : 0 < 8), Nat.mul_comm n 8]
      exact hlt
    unfold bswapBytes
    rw [getLsbD_bswapBytesAux x n i hlt, decide_eq_true hdiv_lt,
      decide_eq_true hlt, Bool.true_and]

/-- Byte reversal is an involution for every byte count `n`. -/
@[simp] theorem bswapBytes_bswapBytes (n : Nat) (x : BitVec (8 * n)) :
    bswapBytes n (bswapBytes n x) = x := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  have hdiv_lt : Nat.div i 8 < n := by
    rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos, Nat.mul_comm n 8]
    exact hi
  have hdiv_le : Nat.div i 8 ≤ n - 1 := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hdiv_lt
  have hrev_lt : n - 1 - Nat.div i 8 < n :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le (n - 1) (Nat.div i 8))
      (Nat.sub_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hdiv_lt) Nat.one_pos)
  let j := Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8)
  have hj_lt : j < 8 * n := by
    have hmod_lt : Nat.mod i 8 < 8 := nat_mod_lt i h8pos
    have h1 : j < 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_right hmod_lt _
    have h2 : 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) =
        8 * ((n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
    have h3 : 8 * ((n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) + 1) ≤ 8 * n :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left 8 hrev_lt
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h3
  have hj_div : Nat.div j 8 = n - 1 - Nat.div i 8 := by
    unfold j
    rw [nat_add_mul_div_left _ _ h8pos,
      nat_div_eq_of_lt (nat_mod_lt i h8pos), Nat.zero_add]
  have hj_mod : Nat.mod j 8 = Nat.mod i 8 := by
    unfold j
    rw [nat_add_mul_mod_self_left, nat_mod_eq_of_lt (nat_mod_lt i h8pos)]
  have hj_back : Nat.mod j 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div j 8) = i := by
    rw [hj_mod, hj_div, nat_sub_sub_self hdiv_le, Nat.add_comm]
    exact nat_div_add_mod i 8
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hj_lt, Bool.true_and, hj_back]

/-- Byte reversal is injective for every byte count `n`. -/
theorem bswapBytes_injective {n : Nat} {x y : BitVec (8 * n)}
    (h : bswapBytes n x = bswapBytes n y) : x = y := by
  rw [← bswapBytes_bswapBytes n x, ← bswapBytes_bswapBytes n y, h]

/-- Exact soundness of tnum byte reversal (`bswapBytes`). -/
theorem tnum_bswapBytes_sound (n : Nat) {m x val : BitVec (8 * n)}
    (h : Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq m x val) :
    Anneal.BitVec.MaskEq (bswapBytes n m) (bswapBytes n x)
      (bswapBytes n val) := by
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.maskEq_iff_getLsbD]
  intro i hi hm
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  have hdiv_lt : Nat.div i 8 < n := by
    rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos, Nat.mul_comm n 8]
    exact hi
  have hrev_lt : n - 1 - Nat.div i 8 < n :=
    Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le (n - 1) (Nat.div i 8))
      (Nat.sub_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hdiv_lt) Nat.one_pos)
  have hj_lt : Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) < 8 * n := by
    have h1 : Nat.mod i 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) <
        8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_right (nat_mod_lt i h8pos) _
    have h2 : 8 + 8 * (n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) =
        8 * ((n - 1 - Nat.div i 8) + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 8 hrev_lt)
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and] at hm
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi,
    Bool.true_and]
  exact Anneal.BitVec.maskEq_iff_getLsbD.1 h _ hj_lt hm

/-- 16-bit byte swap (`u16::swap_bytes`). -/
@[expose] def bswap16 (x : BitVec 16) : BitVec 16 :=
  bswapBytes 2 x

/-- 32-bit byte swap (`u32::swap_bytes`). -/
@[expose] def bswap32 (x : BitVec 32) : BitVec 32 :=
  bswapBytes 4 x

/-- 64-bit byte swap (`u64::swap_bytes`). -/
@[expose] def bswap64 (x : BitVec 64) : BitVec 64 :=
  bswapBytes 8 x

/-- `bswap16` is an involution (`bswap16 (bswap16 x) = x`). -/
@[simp] theorem bswap16_bswap16 (x : BitVec 16) :
    bswap16 (bswap16 x) = x :=
  bswapBytes_bswapBytes 2 x

/-- `bswap32` is an involution (`bswap32 (bswap32 x) = x`). -/
@[simp] theorem bswap32_bswap32 (x : BitVec 32) :
    bswap32 (bswap32 x) = x :=
  bswapBytes_bswapBytes 4 x

/-- `bswap64` is an involution (`bswap64 (bswap64 x) = x`). -/
@[simp] theorem bswap64_bswap64 (x : BitVec 64) :
    bswap64 (bswap64 x) = x :=
  bswapBytes_bswapBytes 8 x

/-- `bswap16` is injective. -/
theorem bswap16_injective {x y : BitVec 16} (h : bswap16 x = bswap16 y) :
    x = y :=
  bswapBytes_injective h

/-- `bswap32` is injective. -/
theorem bswap32_injective {x y : BitVec 32} (h : bswap32 x = bswap32 y) :
    x = y :=
  bswapBytes_injective h

/-- `bswap64` is injective. -/
theorem bswap64_injective {x y : BitVec 64} (h : bswap64 x = bswap64 y) :
    x = y :=
  bswapBytes_injective h

/-- Shift-and-OR characterization of `bswap16`:
`bswap16 x = (x >>> 8) ||| (x <<< 8)`. -/
theorem bswap16_eq_ushr_or_shl (x : BitVec 16) :
    bswap16 x =
      Anneal.BitVec.or (Anneal.BitVec.ushr x 8) (Anneal.BitVec.shl x 8) := by
  apply Anneal.BitVec.eq_of_getLsbD_eq
  intro i hi
  unfold bswap16
  rw [getLsbD_bswapBytes, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ushr,
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_shl, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and]
  have h8pos : 0 < 8 := by decide
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge i 8 with
  | inl hlt =>
    rw [decide_eq_false (Nat.not_le_of_gt hlt), Bool.false_and, Bool.or_false,
      nat_div_eq_of_lt hlt, nat_mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
  | inr hge =>
    have hdiv1 : Nat.div i 8 = 1 := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ Nat.div i 8 := by
        rw [nat_le_div_iff_mul_le h8pos, Nat.one_mul]
        exact hge
      have h2 : Nat.div i 8 < 2 := by
        rw [nat_div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8pos]
        exact hi
      exact Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h2) h1
    have hmod_eq : Nat.mod i 8 = i - 8 := by
      have hdecomp := nat_div_add_mod i 8
      rw [hdiv1, Nat.mul_one] at hdecomp
      have h1 := congrArg (fun z => z - 8) hdecomp
      rw [Nat.add_comm 8 (Nat.mod i 8), Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
      exact h1
    have hge16 : 16 ≤ i + 8 := Nat.add_le_add_right hge 8
    rw [decide_eq_true hge, Bool.true_and, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge x hge16,
      Bool.false_or, hdiv1, hmod_eq]
    rfl

end Anneal.BitVecArith

/-!
# Foundation-Locked Classical Excluded Middle & Choice (`Anneal.ClassicalEm`)

Anneal's 51 locked `Init.*` foundation modules exclude `Init.Classical`, and
`TrustedBoundary.allowedTheoryTacticKinds` excludes `by_cases`. This module
derives Diaconescu's theorem (`prop_em : p ∨ ¬ p`), double-negation elimination
(`of_not_not`), proof by contradiction (`by_contra`), classical logical bridges
(`imp_iff_not_or`, `not_and_iff_or_not`), and existential witness selection
(`chooseExists` / `chooseExists_spec`) directly from `Init.Core` using only
`[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (`Quot.sound` via `funext`) and
allowed Pass-1 tactics (`0` `._unsafe_rec`).

Usage in Pass-1 proofs (replacing `by_cases h : P`):
```lean
cases prop_em P with
| inl h => ...
| inr h => ...
```
-/

namespace Anneal.ClassicalEm

/-! ## 1. Classical Choice and Excluded Middle -/

/-- Extracts a witness from `Nonempty (Subtype P)` using `Classical.choice`. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def chooseSub {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : α :=
  (Classical.choice h).1

/-- Specification of `chooseSub`: the chosen witness satisfies `P`. -/
theorem chooseSub_spec {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : P (chooseSub h) :=
  (Classical.choice h).2

private noncomputable def chooseBool (P : Bool → Prop)
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : Bool :=
  (Classical.choice h).1

private theorem chooseBool_spec (P : Bool → Prop)
    (h : Nonempty (Subtype P)) : P (chooseBool P h) :=
  (Classical.choice h).2

private theorem chooseBool_congr {P Q : Bool → Prop} (hPQ : P = Q)
    (hP : Nonempty (Subtype P)) (hQ : Nonempty (Subtype Q)) :
    chooseBool P hP = chooseBool Q hQ := by
  subst hPQ
  rfl

private theorem bool_eq_or_ne (a b : Bool) : a = b ∨ a ≠ b := by
  cases a with
  | false =>
    cases b with
    | false => exact Or.inl rfl
    | true => exact Or.inr (fun h => by nomatch h)
  | true =>
    cases b with
    | false => exact Or.inr (fun h => by nomatch h)
    | true => exact Or.inl rfl

/-- Diaconescu's theorem (`p ∨ ¬ p`) over `prelude` + `Init.Core` without
`Init.Classical`, replacing banned `by_cases` via `cases prop_em p`. -/
theorem prop_em (p : Prop) : p ∨ ¬ p := by
  let U (x : Bool) : Prop := x = true ∨ p
  let V (x : Bool) : Prop := x = false ∨ p
  have exU : Nonempty (Subtype U) := ⟨⟨true, Or.inl rfl⟩⟩
  have exV : Nonempty (Subtype V) := ⟨⟨false, Or.inl rfl⟩⟩
  have hu : U (chooseBool U exU) := chooseBool_spec U exU
  have hv : V (chooseBool V exV) := chooseBool_spec V exV
  cases bool_eq_or_ne (chooseBool U exU) (chooseBool V exV) with
  | inr hne =>
    refine Or.inr ?_
    intro hp
    have hUV : U = V := by
      funext x
      exact propext ⟨fun _ => Or.inr hp, fun _ => Or.inr hp⟩
    exact hne (chooseBool_congr hUV exU exV)
  | inl heq =>
    cases hu with
    | inr hp => exact Or.inl hp
    | inl hut =>
      cases hv with
      | inr hp => exact Or.inl hp
      | inl hvf =>
        rw [hut, hvf] at heq
        nomatch heq

/-- Classical double-negation elimination derived from `prop_em`. -/
theorem of_not_not {p : Prop} (hnn : ¬ ¬ p) : p := by
  cases prop_em p with
  | inl hp => exact hp
  | inr hnp => exact False.elim (hnn hnp)

/-- Classical proof by contradiction (`(¬ p → False) → p`). -/
theorem by_contra {p : Prop} (h : ¬ p → False) : p :=
  of_not_not h

/-- Classical equivalence between `p → q` and `¬ p ∨ q`. -/
theorem imp_iff_not_or (p q : Prop) : (p → q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ q) := by
  constructor
  · intro hpq
    cases prop_em p with
    | inl hp => exact Or.inr (hpq hp)
    | inr hnp => exact Or.inl hnp
  · intro h hp
    cases h with
    | inl hnp => exact False.elim (hnp hp)
    | inr hq => exact hq

/-- Classical De Morgan equivalence (`¬ (p ∧ q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ ¬ q)`). -/
theorem not_and_iff_or_not (p q : Prop) : ¬ (p ∧ q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ ¬ q) := by
  constructor
  · intro hna
    cases prop_em p with
    | inr hnp => exact Or.inl hnp
    | inl hp =>
      exact Or.inr (fun hq => hna ⟨hp, hq⟩)
  · intro hor hpq
    cases hor with
    | inl hnp => exact hnp hpq.1
    | inr hnq => exact hnq hpq.2

/-- Selects a witness from an existential proof using `Classical.choice`.

Uses a pure elimination term rather than a `by` block so Lean can export the
`@[expose]` body cleanly in `module` mode without stuck metavariables. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def chooseExists {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : ∃ x : α, P x) : α :=
  chooseSub (Exists.elim h fun w hw => ⟨⟨w, hw⟩⟩)

/-- Specification of `chooseExists`: the selected witness satisfies `P`. -/
theorem chooseExists_spec {α : Sort u} {P : α → Prop}
    (h : ∃ x : α, P x) : P (chooseExists h) :=
  chooseSub_spec (Exists.elim h fun w hw => ⟨⟨w, hw⟩⟩)

/-! ## 2. Kernel-Checked Canaries -/

/-- Canary exercising `prop_em` on concrete propositions `True` and `False`. -/
theorem canary_prop_em_concrete : (True ∨ ¬ True) ∧ (False ∨ ¬ False) :=
  ⟨prop_em True, prop_em False⟩

/-- Canary exercising `of_not_not` and `by_contra` on an arbitrary `Prop`. -/
theorem canary_not_not_by_contra (p : Prop) :
    (¬ ¬ p → p) ∧ ((¬ p → False) → p) :=
  ⟨of_not_not, by_contra⟩

/-- Canary exercising `imp_iff_not_or` and `not_and_iff_or_not`. -/
theorem canary_logic_bridges (p q : Prop) :
    ((p → q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ q)) ∧ (¬ (p ∧ q) ↔ (¬ p ∨ ¬ q)) :=
  ⟨imp_iff_not_or p q, not_and_iff_or_not p q⟩

/-- Canary exercising `chooseExists` on an inhabited positive `Nat` witness. -/
theorem canary_chooseExists_pos :
    0 < chooseExists (⟨1, Nat.zero_lt_succ 0⟩ : ∃ n : Nat, 0 < n) :=
  chooseExists_spec ⟨1, Nat.zero_lt_succ 0⟩

/-- Canary refuting an unsatisfiable existential via `chooseExists`. -/
theorem canary_chooseExists_false_rejected : ¬ ∃ n : Nat, n < n :=
  fun h => Nat.lt_irrefl (chooseExists h) (chooseExists_spec h)

end Anneal.ClassicalEm

end

/-!
# WHNF and Rewrite Firewalls (`Anneal.Firewall`)

Pass-1-portable (`prelude` + `Init.Core` only, zero axioms, zero
`._unsafe_rec`, zero `noncomputable`) barriers that stop Lean's kernel `whnf`
and tactic `rw` / `simp` traversals from penetrating large symbolic
weakest-precondition or MIR state expressions.

Two complementary mechanisms are provided:

1. **`Firewall tag P` (1-Field `Prop` Structure):**
   In Lean 4's kernel, a structure type constructor is never delta-unfolded,
   so `Firewall t₁ P` and `Firewall t₂ P` are not definitionally equal for
   distinct tags (`tag : Nat`), unlike a `def`/`abbrev` wrapper. Use
   `Firewall` to wrap intermediate symbolic obligations with an explicit tag
   separator.

2. **`IndexedCut` (Zero-`Prop`-Argument Indexed Step-Cut Combinator):**
   Even when `Firewall tag P` blocks head delta-unfolding, `P` still appears in
   the goal type's `Expr` arguments, so tactics like `rw` traverse `P` searching
   for redexes. Binding a stepped predicate `cutAt : Nat → σ → Prop` inside an
   `IndexedCut` (or marking a concrete `def myCut (stage : Nat) (st : σ) : Prop`
   `@[irreducible]` *after* proving its `seal`/`open`/`step` lemmas) keeps the
   expanded `Prop` expression out of the outer goal signature.
-/

namespace Anneal.Firewall

/-! ## 1. Tagged 1-Field `Prop` Structure (`Firewall`) -/

/-- Wrap `P : Prop` inside a kernel-opaque 1-field structure indexed by an
explicit `tag : Nat` separator. -/
structure Firewall (tag : Nat) (P : Prop) : Prop where
  /-- Extract the underlying proposition `P`. -/
  val : P

/-- Wrap a proof of `P` inside `Firewall tag P`. -/
theorem wrap (tag : Nat) {P : Prop} (h : P) : Firewall tag P :=
  ⟨h⟩

/-- Extract a proof of `P` from `Firewall tag P`. -/
theorem unwrap {tag : Nat} {P : Prop} (h : Firewall tag P) : P :=
  h.val

/-- Transform the proposition wrapped inside `Firewall tag P` while preserving
`tag`. -/
theorem map (tag : Nat) {P Q : Prop} (f : P → Q) (h : Firewall tag P) :
    Firewall tag Q :=
  ⟨f h.val⟩

/-- Combine two firewalled propositions `Firewall tag P` and `Firewall tag Q`
under `f : P → Q → R`. -/
theorem map2 (tag : Nat) {P Q R : Prop} (f : P → Q → R)
    (hp : Firewall tag P) (hq : Firewall tag Q) : Firewall tag R :=
  ⟨f hp.val hq.val⟩

/-- Re-tag a firewalled obligation from `tag1` to `tag2`. -/
theorem trans_tag (tag1 tag2 : Nat) {P : Prop} (h : Firewall tag1 P) :
    Firewall tag2 P :=
  ⟨h.val⟩

/-! ## 2. Zero-`Prop`-Argument Indexed Step-Cut Combinator (`IndexedCut`) -/

/-- Wrap a state-indexed family of propositions `cutAt : Nat → σ → Prop`
without exposing expanded `Prop` bodies in the outer goal signature when
`cutAt` is bound to a top-level named definition. -/
structure IndexedCut {σ : Type u} (cutAt : Nat → σ → Prop)
    (stage : Nat) (st : σ) : Prop where
  /-- Unseal the underlying stage obligation `cutAt stage st`. -/
  runCut : cutAt stage st

/-- Seal `cutAt stage st` into an `IndexedCut cutAt stage st` wrapper. -/
theorem seal_cut {σ : Type u} {cutAt : Nat → σ → Prop}
    {stage : Nat} {st : σ} (h : cutAt stage st) :
    IndexedCut cutAt stage st :=
  ⟨h⟩

/-- Extract `cutAt stage st` from `IndexedCut cutAt stage st`. -/
theorem open_cut {σ : Type u} {cutAt : Nat → σ → Prop}
    {stage : Nat} {st : σ} (h : IndexedCut cutAt stage st) :
    cutAt stage st :=
  h.runCut

/-- Advance a sealed `IndexedCut` backward from `(stage2, st2)` to
`(stage1, st1)` along `hAdv`. -/
theorem step_cut {σ : Type u} {cutAt : Nat → σ → Prop}
    {stage1 stage2 : Nat} {st1 st2 : σ}
    (hAdv : cutAt stage2 st2 → cutAt stage1 st1)
    (hNext : IndexedCut cutAt stage2 st2) :
    IndexedCut cutAt stage1 st1 :=
  ⟨hAdv hNext.runCut⟩

/-- Discharge final goal `post` from a sealed `IndexedCut` via `hDone`. -/
theorem finish_cut {σ : Type u} {cutAt : Nat → σ → Prop}
    {stage : Nat} {st : σ} {post : Prop}
    (hDone : cutAt stage st → post)
    (hCut : IndexedCut cutAt stage st) : post :=
  hDone hCut.runCut

/-! ## 3. Kernel-Checked Canaries -/

/-- Exercise `wrap`, `trans_tag`, and `unwrap` on a conjunctive proposition. -/
theorem canary_wrap_unwrap_tag {P Q : Prop} (hp : P) (hq : Q) : P ∧ Q :=
  let h0 : Firewall 0 (P ∧ Q) := wrap 0 ⟨hp, hq⟩
  let h7 : Firewall 7 (P ∧ Q) := trans_tag 0 7 h0
  unwrap h7

/-- Exercise `map` and `map2` combining independently firewalled inputs. -/
theorem canary_map_and_map2 {P Q R : Prop}
    (fp : P → Q) (hp : Firewall 3 P) (hr : Firewall 3 R) : Q ∧ R :=
  let hq : Firewall 3 Q := map 3 fp hp
  unwrap (map2 3 And.intro hq hr)

private def sampleStageCut (stage st : Nat) : Prop :=
  match stage with
  | 0 => st = 0
  | 1 => st = 0 ∧ True
  | _ + 2 => st = 0 ∧ True ∧ True

/-- Exercise `seal_cut`, `step_cut`, `open_cut`, and `finish_cut` over a
concrete 3-stage `IndexedCut` chain. -/
theorem canary_indexed_cut_chain {n : Nat} (hn : n = 0) : n = 0 :=
  let h2 : IndexedCut sampleStageCut 2 n :=
    seal_cut ⟨hn, True.intro, True.intro⟩
  let h1 : IndexedCut sampleStageCut 1 n :=
    step_cut (cutAt := sampleStageCut) (stage1 := 1) (stage2 := 2)
      (st1 := n) (st2 := n) (fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩) h2
  let h0 : IndexedCut sampleStageCut 0 n :=
    step_cut (cutAt := sampleStageCut) (stage1 := 0) (stage2 := 1)
      (st1 := n) (st2 := n) (fun h => h.1) h1
  let _opened : sampleStageCut 0 n := open_cut h0
  finish_cut (cutAt := sampleStageCut) (stage := 0) (st := n) (fun h => h) h0

private def sampleIrrCut (stage st : Nat) : Prop :=
  match stage with
  | 0 => st = 0
  | _ + 1 => st = 0 ∧ True

private theorem sampleIrrCut_init {st : Nat} (h : st = 0) :
    sampleIrrCut 1 st :=
  ⟨h, True.intro⟩

private theorem sampleIrrCut_step {st : Nat} :
    sampleIrrCut 1 st → sampleIrrCut 0 st :=
  fun h => h.1

private theorem sampleIrrCut_done {st : Nat} :
    sampleIrrCut 0 st → st = 0 :=
  fun h => h

attribute [irreducible] sampleIrrCut

/-- Verify `seal_cut`, `step_cut`, `open_cut`, and `finish_cut` compose over a
predicate marked `@[irreducible]` after its step lemmas are proved. -/
theorem canary_irreducible_indexed_cut {st : Nat} (h : st = 0) : st = 0 :=
  let h1 : IndexedCut sampleIrrCut 1 st := seal_cut (sampleIrrCut_init h)
  let h0 : IndexedCut sampleIrrCut 0 st := step_cut sampleIrrCut_step h1
  let _opened : sampleIrrCut 0 st := open_cut h0
  finish_cut sampleIrrCut_done h0

end Anneal.Firewall

/-!
# Generic Fuel-Bounded Step & Checkpoint WPs (`Anneal.Framework.StepWp`)

Purely MIR-agnostic (`Trusted.MirModel.StepResult` only, `0` operational
semantics, `0` axioms beyond `propext`) step-transition calculus unifying:

1. `BoolCertCut` (`@[irreducible]`, `0` `Prop` args): reflective certificate
   firewall sealing `check cert = true`.
2. `wpStepPred` / `wlpStepPred` / `execStepPred` (+ outcome-only abbrevs):
   fuel-bounded demonic and deterministic weakest preconditions over arbitrary
   `step : C → S → StepResult S Out`.
3. `wpUntilPred` / `execUntilPred` / `wpUntilCutStep` and `@[irreducible]
   StepStageCut`: checkpoint weakest preconditions, cutpoint barriers, and
   sequential fuel composition.
4. Generic loop-induction, well-founded `Acc`, countdown, list-traversal,
   abstract-simulation, bounded early-return (`wpIterCut`), and deterministic
   `Nat`-rank termination rules.
-/

/-! ## 1. Reflective Zero-`Prop`-Argument Certificate Barrier (`BoolCertCut`) -/

/-- Zero-`Prop`-argument reflective certificate barrier asserting that
computable checker `check : Code → Bool` accepts certificate `cert : Code`
(`check cert = true`), sealed `@[irreducible]` below after its seal, unseal,
and pairing laws. -/
@[expose] def BoolCertCut {Code : Type} (check : Code → Bool)
    (cert : Code) : Prop :=
  check cert = true

/-- Seals a concrete or derived `check cert = true` witness behind
`BoolCertCut`. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.seal {Code : Type} (check : Code → Bool) (cert : Code)
    (h : check cert = true) : BoolCertCut check cert :=
  h

/-- Unseals `BoolCertCut check cert` back to `check cert = true`. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.unseal {Code : Type} {check : Code → Bool} {cert : Code}
    (h : BoolCertCut check cert) : check cert = true :=
  h

/-- Applies a pointwise soundness implication directly to a sealed
`BoolCertCut` witness without exposing the definition to tactics. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.elim {Code : Type} {check : Code → Bool} {cert : Code}
    {P : Prop} (hSound : check cert = true → P)
    (hCut : BoolCertCut check cert) : P :=
  hSound hCut

/-- Applies a universal checker soundness theorem
`∀ c, check c = true → interp c` to a sealed `BoolCertCut check cert`. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.sound {Code : Type} {check : Code → Bool}
    {interp : Code → Prop}
    (hSound : ∀ c : Code, check c = true → interp c)
    {cert : Code} (hCut : BoolCertCut check cert) : interp cert :=
  hSound cert hCut

/-- Pointwise checker congruence for `BoolCertCut`. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.congr_check {Code : Type}
    {check₁ check₂ : Code → Bool}
    (hEq : ∀ c : Code, check₁ c = check₂ c) {cert : Code} :
    BoolCertCut check₁ cert ↔ BoolCertCut check₂ cert := by
  unfold BoolCertCut
  rw [hEq cert]

/-- Conjoins two `BoolCertCut` witnesses into a single paired certificate
checker without introducing any `Prop` arguments. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.pair {C₁ C₂ : Type}
    {check₁ : C₁ → Bool} {check₂ : C₂ → Bool} {c₁ : C₁} {c₂ : C₂}
    (h₁ : BoolCertCut check₁ c₁) (h₂ : BoolCertCut check₂ c₂) :
    BoolCertCut (fun p : C₁ × C₂ => check₁ p.1 && check₂ p.2) (c₁, c₂) := by
  unfold BoolCertCut at h₁ h₂
  unfold BoolCertCut
  dsimp only
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  rfl

/-- Extracts the left `BoolCertCut` component from a paired certificate. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.fst {C₁ C₂ : Type}
    {check₁ : C₁ → Bool} {check₂ : C₂ → Bool} {c₁ : C₁} {c₂ : C₂}
    (h : BoolCertCut (fun p : C₁ × C₂ => check₁ p.1 && check₂ p.2)
      (c₁, c₂)) :
    BoolCertCut check₁ c₁ := by
  unfold BoolCertCut at h
  unfold BoolCertCut
  dsimp only at h
  cases h1 : check₁ c₁ with
  | true => rfl
  | false =>
    rw [h1] at h
    cases h

/-- Extracts the right `BoolCertCut` component from a paired certificate. -/
theorem BoolCertCut.snd {C₁ C₂ : Type}
    {check₁ : C₁ → Bool} {check₂ : C₂ → Bool} {c₁ : C₁} {c₂ : C₂}
    (h : BoolCertCut (fun p : C₁ × C₂ => check₁ p.1 && check₂ p.2)
      (c₁, c₂)) :
    BoolCertCut check₂ c₂ := by
  unfold BoolCertCut at h
  unfold BoolCertCut
  dsimp only at h
  cases h1 : check₁ c₁ with
  | false =>
    rw [h1] at h
    cases h
  | true =>
    rw [h1, Bool.true_and] at h
    exact h

attribute [irreducible] BoolCertCut

/-! ## 2. Generic Step WP (`wpStepPred`, `wlpStepPred`, `execStepPred`) -/

/-- Fuel-bounded demonic weakest precondition over an arbitrary step function
`step : C → S → StepResult S Out`, passing the pre-step state alongside
`.done` and `.fault` outcomes. Uses `@Nat.rec` into `Prop` so kernel
evaluation avoids `_unsafe_rec` and codegen exemptions. -/
@[expose] def wpStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out)
    (onDone : S → Out → Prop) (onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => S → Prop)
    (fun _ => False)
    (fun _ ih st =>
      (∃ c₀ : C, validChoice st c₀) ∧
      ∀ c : C, validChoice st c →
        match step c st with
        | .step st' => ih st'
        | .done out => onDone st out
        | .fault k => onFault st k)
    fuel s

/-- Outcome-only specialization of `wpStepPred`. -/
abbrev wpStepOutcome {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out)
    (onDone : Out → Prop) (onFault : FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  wpStepPred validChoice step (fun _ => onDone) (fun _ => onFault) fuel s

/-- Weakest liberal precondition over `step`: running out of fuel yields
`True`, while every `.done` / `.fault` within `fuel` must satisfy `onDone` /
`onFault`. -/
@[expose] def wlpStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out)
    (onDone : S → Out → Prop) (onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => S → Prop)
    (fun _ => True)
    (fun _ ih st =>
      ∀ c : C, validChoice st c →
        match step c st with
        | .step st' => ih st'
        | .done out => onDone st out
        | .fault k => onFault st k)
    fuel s

/-- Outcome-only specialization of `wlpStepPred`. -/
abbrev wlpStepOutcome {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out)
    (onDone : Out → Prop) (onFault : FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  wlpStepPred validChoice step (fun _ => onDone) (fun _ => onFault) fuel s

/-- Deterministic counterpart of `wpStepPred` over
`step : S → StepResult S Out`. Concrete runs reduce directly by `rfl`. -/
@[expose] def execStepPred {S Out : Type}
    (step : S → StepResult S Out)
    (onDone : S → Out → Prop) (onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => S → Prop)
    (fun _ => False)
    (fun _ ih st =>
      match step st with
      | .step st' => ih st'
      | .done out => onDone st out
      | .fault k => onFault st k)
    fuel s

/-- Outcome-only specialization of `execStepPred`. -/
abbrev execStepOutcome {S Out : Type}
    (step : S → StepResult S Out)
    (onDone : Out → Prop) (onFault : FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  execStepPred step (fun _ => onDone) (fun _ => onFault) fuel s

/-- Unfold `wpStepPred` at fuel `0`. -/
theorem wpStepPred_zero_iff {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} {s : S} :
    wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault 0 s ↔ False :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Unfold `wpStepPred` at fuel `fuel + 1`. -/
theorem wpStepPred_succ_iff {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S} :
    wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault (fuel + 1) s ↔
      ((∃ c₀ : C, validChoice s c₀) ∧
        ∀ c : C, validChoice s c →
          match step c s with
          | .step st' => wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel st'
          | .done out => onDone s out
          | .fault k => onFault s k) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Unfold `execStepPred` at fuel `0`. -/
theorem execStepPred_zero_iff {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} {s : S} :
    execStepPred step onDone onFault 0 s ↔ False :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Unfold `execStepPred` at fuel `fuel + 1`. -/
theorem execStepPred_succ_iff {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S} :
    execStepPred step onDone onFault (fuel + 1) s ↔
      (match step s with
        | .step st' => execStepPred step onDone onFault fuel st'
        | .done out => onDone s out
        | .fault k => onFault s k) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Transport `wpStepPred` along an equality of fuel budgets. -/
theorem wpStepPred_fuel_cast {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {a b : Nat} {s : S} (hEq : a = b)
    (h : wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault a s) :
    wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault b s := by
  subst hEq
  exact h

/-- Transport `execStepPred` along an equality of fuel budgets. -/
theorem execStepPred_fuel_cast {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {a b : Nat} {s : S} (hEq : a = b)
    (h : execStepPred step onDone onFault a s) :
    execStepPred step onDone onFault b s := by
  subst hEq
  exact h

/-- Exact equivalence between `wpStepPred` and deterministic `execStepPred`
whenever `validChoice` admits a unique choice `c₀` at every state. -/
theorem wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} {s : S},
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel s ↔
      execStepPred (step c₀) onDone onFault fuel s
  | 0, _ => Iff.rfl
  | fuel + 1, s => by
    change ((∃ cInit : C, validChoice s cInit) ∧
        ∀ c : C, validChoice s c →
          match step c s with
          | .step st' => wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel st'
          | .done out => onDone s out
          | .fault k => onFault s k) ↔
      (match step c₀ s with
        | .step st' => execStepPred (step c₀) onDone onFault fuel st'
        | .done out => onDone s out
        | .fault k => onFault s k)
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h0 := h.2 c₀ ((hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl)
      cases hStep : step c₀ s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        exact (wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred hUnique).mp h0
      | done out =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        exact h0
      | fault k =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        exact h0
    · intro h
      refine ⟨⟨c₀, (hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl⟩, fun c hc => ?_⟩
      have hcEq : c = c₀ := (hUnique s c).mp hc
      subst hcEq
      cases hStep : step c s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at h
        exact (wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred hUnique).mpr h
      | done out =>
        rw [hStep] at h
        exact h
      | fault k =>
        rw [hStep] at h
        exact h

/-- Lift deterministic `execStepPred` into `wpStepPred`. -/
theorem wpStepPred_of_execStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : execStepPred (step c₀) onDone onFault fuel s) :
    wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel s :=
  (wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred hUnique).mpr h

/-- Project `wpStepPred` onto deterministic `execStepPred`. -/
theorem execStepPred_of_wpStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel s) :
    execStepPred (step c₀) onDone onFault fuel s :=
  (wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred hUnique).mp h

/-- Rule of consequence for `wpStepPred`. -/
theorem wpStepPred_mono {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone₁ onDone₂ : S → Out → Prop}
    {onFault₁ onFault₂ : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    (hDone : ∀ s out, onDone₁ s out → onDone₂ s out)
    (hFault : ∀ s k, onFault₁ s k → onFault₂ s k) :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} {s : S},
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone₁ onFault₁ fuel s →
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone₂ onFault₂ fuel s
  | 0, _, h => False.elim h
  | fuel + 1, s, h => by
    refine ⟨h.1, fun c hc => ?_⟩
    have hc' := h.2 c hc
    cases hStep : step c s with
    | step st' =>
      rw [hStep] at hc'
      exact wpStepPred_mono hDone hFault hc'
    | done out =>
      rw [hStep] at hc'
      exact hDone s out hc'
    | fault k =>
      rw [hStep] at hc'
      exact hFault s k hc'

/-- Rule of consequence for `execStepPred` (derived from `wpStepPred_mono`).
-/
theorem execStepPred_mono {S Out : Type} {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone₁ onDone₂ : S → Out → Prop}
    {onFault₁ onFault₂ : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    (hDone : ∀ s out, onDone₁ s out → onDone₂ s out)
    (hFault : ∀ s k, onFault₁ s k → onFault₂ s k)
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : execStepPred step onDone₁ onFault₁ fuel s) :
    execStepPred step onDone₂ onFault₂ fuel s :=
  (wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
      (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mp
    (wpStepPred_mono hDone hFault
      ((wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
        (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mpr h))

/-- Fuel weakening `fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂` for `wpStepPred`. -/
theorem wpStepPred_fuel_mono {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel₁ fuel₂ : Nat} {s : S},
      fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂ →
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel₁ s →
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel₂ s
  | 0, _, _, _, h => False.elim h
  | fuel₁ + 1, 0, _, hLe, _ =>
    False.elim (Nat.not_succ_le_zero fuel₁ hLe)
  | fuel₁ + 1, fuel₂ + 1, s, hLe, h => by
    have hLe' : fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂ := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hLe
    refine ⟨h.1, fun c hc => ?_⟩
    have hc' := h.2 c hc
    cases hStep : step c s with
    | step st' =>
      rw [hStep] at hc'
      exact wpStepPred_fuel_mono hLe' hc'
    | done _ =>
      rw [hStep] at hc'
      exact hc'
    | fault _ =>
      rw [hStep] at hc'
      exact hc'

/-- Fuel weakening `fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂` for `execStepPred`. -/
theorem execStepPred_fuel_mono {S Out : Type} {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel₁ fuel₂ : Nat} {s : S} (hLe : fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂)
    (h : execStepPred step onDone onFault fuel₁ s) :
    execStepPred step onDone onFault fuel₂ s :=
  (wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
      (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mp
    (wpStepPred_fuel_mono hLe
      ((wpStepPred_iff_execStepPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
        (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mpr h))

/-- Pointwise step-function congruence for `execStepPred`. -/
theorem execStepPred_congr {S Out : Type}
    {step₁ step₂ : S → StepResult S Out}
    (hEq : ∀ s : S, step₁ s = step₂ s)
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} {s : S},
      execStepPred step₁ onDone onFault fuel s →
      execStepPred step₂ onDone onFault fuel s
  | 0, _, h => False.elim h
  | fuel + 1, s, h => by
    rw [execStepPred_succ_iff] at h
    rw [execStepPred_succ_iff, ← hEq s]
    cases hS : step₁ s with
    | step st' =>
      rw [hS] at h
      exact execStepPred_congr hEq h
    | done out =>
      rw [hS] at h
      exact h
    | fault k =>
      rw [hS] at h
      exact h

/-- Bisimulation across state projection `map : S₁ → S₂` preserving invariant
`Inv` and single-step outcomes. -/
theorem execStepOutcome_bisim {S₁ S₂ Out : Type}
    {step₁ : S₁ → StepResult S₁ Out} {step₂ : S₂ → StepResult S₂ Out}
    {Inv : S₁ → Prop} {map : S₁ → S₂}
    (hInvStep : ∀ s s', Inv s → step₁ s = .step s' → Inv s')
    (hSim : ∀ s, Inv s →
      step₂ (map s) =
        match step₁ s with
        | .step s' => .step (map s')
        | .done out => .done out
        | .fault k => .fault k)
    {onDone : Out → Prop} {onFault : FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} {s : S₁}, Inv s →
      (execStepOutcome step₂ onDone onFault fuel (map s) ↔
       execStepOutcome step₁ onDone onFault fuel s)
  | 0, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | fuel + 1, s, hInv => by
    dsimp only [execStepOutcome]
    rw [execStepPred_succ_iff, execStepPred_succ_iff, hSim s hInv]
    cases hSt : step₁ s with
    | step next =>
      exact execStepOutcome_bisim hInvStep hSim (hInvStep s next hInv hSt)
    | done _ => exact Iff.rfl
    | fault _ => exact Iff.rfl

/-- Single-step introduction for `wpStepPred` along a deterministic step. -/
theorem wpStepPred_step {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : match step c₀ s with
      | .step st' => wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel st'
      | .done out => onDone s out
      | .fault k => onFault s k) :
    wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault (fuel + 1) s := by
  refine wpStepPred_succ_iff.mpr ⟨⟨c₀, (hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl⟩, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  have hEq : c = c₀ := (hUnique s c).mp hc
  subst hEq
  exact h

/-- Conjunctive split combining total `wpStepPred` with liberal `wlpStepPred`
without re-proving termination. -/
theorem wpStepPred_conj_of_wlp {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone₁ onDone₂ : S → Out → Prop}
    {onFault₁ onFault₂ : S → FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} {s : S},
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone₁ onFault₁ fuel s →
      wlpStepPred validChoice step onDone₂ onFault₂ fuel s →
      wpStepPred validChoice step
        (fun st out => onDone₁ st out ∧ onDone₂ st out)
        (fun st k => onFault₁ st k ∧ onFault₂ st k) fuel s
  | 0, _, hSafe, _ => False.elim hSafe
  | k + 1, s, hSafe, hWlp => by
    refine ⟨hSafe.1, fun c hc => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hSafe.2 c hc
    have h2 := hWlp c hc
    cases hEv : step c s with
    | step st' =>
      rw [hEv] at h1 h2
      exact wpStepPred_conj_of_wlp h1 h2
    | done out =>
      rw [hEv] at h1 h2
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    | fault fk =>
      rw [hEv] at h1 h2
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

/-- Relational small-step transition over `(validChoice, step)`. -/
@[expose] def StepRel {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out)
    (s : S) (res : StepResult S Out) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : C, validChoice s c ∧ step c s = res

/-- Finite-step `.step` reachability over `(validChoice, step)`. -/
inductive StepReaches {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out) :
    S → S → Prop where
  | refl (s : S) : StepReaches validChoice step s s
  | tail {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S} :
      StepReaches validChoice step s₁ s₂ →
      StepRel validChoice step s₂ (.step s₃) →
      StepReaches validChoice step s₁ s₃

/-- Prepend a single step onto `StepReaches`. -/
theorem StepReaches.head {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S}
    (hFirst : StepRel validChoice step s₁ (.step s₂))
    (hRest : StepReaches validChoice step s₂ s₃) :
    StepReaches validChoice step s₁ s₃ := by
  induction hRest with
  | refl => exact StepReaches.tail (StepReaches.refl s₁) hFirst
  | tail _ hLast ih => exact StepReaches.tail ih hLast

/-- Any state reachable from `s₁` preserves `wpStepPred` at some remaining
fuel. -/
theorem wpStepPred_of_reaches {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {s₁ s₂ : S} {fuel : Nat}
    (hWp : wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel s₁)
    (hReach : StepReaches validChoice step s₁ s₂) :
    ∃ fuel', wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel' s₂ := by
  induction hReach with
  | refl => exact ⟨fuel, hWp⟩
  | tail _ hStep ih =>
    let ⟨fuel₁, hWp₁⟩ := ih
    cases fuel₁ with
    | zero => exact False.elim hWp₁
    | succ fuel₂ =>
      let ⟨c, hc, hEval⟩ := hStep
      have hBranch := hWp₁.2 c hc
      rw [hEval] at hBranch
      exact ⟨fuel₂, hBranch⟩

/-- Every state satisfying `wpStepPred` reaches a terminal `.done` or `.fault`
transition within `fuel` steps. -/
theorem exists_terminal_of_wpStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (hWp : wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel s) :
    ∃ sEnd res, StepReaches validChoice step s sEnd ∧
      StepRel validChoice step sEnd res ∧
      match res with
      | .step _ => False
      | .done out => onDone sEnd out
      | .fault k => onFault sEnd k := by
  induction fuel generalizing s with
  | zero => exact False.elim hWp
  | succ f ih =>
    let ⟨⟨c₀, hc₀⟩, hAll⟩ := hWp
    have hStep := hAll c₀ hc₀
    cases hEval : step c₀ s with
    | step s' =>
      rw [hEval] at hStep
      let ⟨sEnd, res, hReach, hTerm, hRes⟩ := ih hStep
      exact ⟨sEnd, res,
        StepReaches.head ⟨c₀, hc₀, hEval⟩ hReach, hTerm, hRes⟩
    | done out =>
      rw [hEval] at hStep
      exact ⟨s, .done out, StepReaches.refl s, ⟨c₀, hc₀, hEval⟩, hStep⟩
    | fault k =>
      rw [hEval] at hStep
      exact ⟨s, .fault k, StepReaches.refl s, ⟨c₀, hc₀, hEval⟩, hStep⟩

/-- No state satisfying `wpStepPred` admits an infinite `.step` trace. -/
theorem not_infinite_trace_of_wpStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} (trace : Nat → S),
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault fuel (trace 0) →
      (∀ n : Nat, StepRel validChoice step (trace n) (.step (trace (n + 1)))) →
      False
  | 0, _, hWp, _ => hWp
  | _ + 1, trace, hWp, hSteps => by
    let ⟨c, hc, hEval⟩ := hSteps 0
    have hBranch := hWp.2 c hc
    rw [hEval] at hBranch
    exact not_infinite_trace_of_wpStepPred (fun n => trace (n + 1))
      hBranch (fun n => hSteps (n + 1))

/-! ## 3. Checkpoint WP (`wpUntilPred`, `execUntilPred`) & `StepStageCut` -/

/-- Fuel-bounded demonic checkpoint weakest precondition over `step`. -/
@[expose] def wpUntilPred {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out)
    (stop : S → Prop) (onDone : S → Out → Prop) (onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => S → Prop)
    (fun st => stop st)
    (fun _ ih st =>
      stop st ∨
      ((∃ c₀ : C, validChoice st c₀) ∧
        ∀ c : C, validChoice st c →
          match step c st with
          | .step st' => ih st'
          | .done out => onDone st out
          | .fault k => onFault st k))
    fuel s

/-- Outcome-only specialization of `wpUntilPred`. -/
abbrev wpUntil {S Out C : Type}
    (validChoice : S → C → Prop) (step : C → S → StepResult S Out)
    (stop : S → Prop) (onDone : Out → Prop) (onFault : FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  wpUntilPred validChoice step stop (fun _ => onDone) (fun _ => onFault) fuel s

/-- Deterministic counterpart of `wpUntilPred` over
`step : S → StepResult S Out`. -/
@[expose] def execUntilPred {S Out : Type}
    (step : S → StepResult S Out)
    (stop : S → Prop) (onDone : S → Out → Prop) (onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => S → Prop)
    (fun st => stop st)
    (fun _ ih st =>
      stop st ∨
      match step st with
      | .step st' => ih st'
      | .done out => onDone st out
      | .fault k => onFault st k)
    fuel s

/-- Outcome-only specialization of `execUntilPred`. -/
abbrev execUntil {S Out : Type}
    (step : S → StepResult S Out)
    (stop : S → Prop) (onDone : Out → Prop) (onFault : FaultKind → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : S) : Prop :=
  execUntilPred step stop (fun _ => onDone) (fun _ => onFault) fuel s

/-- Predicate-level cutpoint weakest precondition over deterministic `step`. -/
abbrev wpUntilCutStep {S Out : Type} (step : S → StepResult S Out)
    (cut : S → Prop) (fuel : Nat) (s₀ : S) : Prop :=
  execUntilPred step cut (fun _ _ => False) (fun _ _ => False) fuel s₀

/-- Unfold `wpUntilPred` at fuel `0`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_zero_iff {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {s : S} :
    wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault 0 s ↔ stop s :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Unfold `wpUntilPred` at fuel `fuel + 1`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_succ_iff {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S} :
    wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault (fuel + 1) s ↔
      (stop s ∨
        ((∃ c₀ : C, validChoice s c₀) ∧
          ∀ c : C, validChoice s c →
            match step c s with
            | .step st' =>
              wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel st'
            | .done out => onDone s out
            | .fault k => onFault s k)) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Unfold `execUntilPred` at fuel `0`. -/
theorem execUntilPred_zero_iff {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {s : S} :
    execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault 0 s ↔ stop s :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Unfold `execUntilPred` at fuel `fuel + 1`. -/
theorem execUntilPred_succ_iff {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S} :
    execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault (fuel + 1) s ↔
      (stop s ∨
        match step s with
        | .step st' => execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault fuel st'
        | .done out => onDone s out
        | .fault k => onFault s k) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Transport `wpUntilPred` along an equality of fuel budgets. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_fuel_cast {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {a b : Nat} {s : S} (hEq : a = b)
    (h : wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault a s) :
    wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault b s := by
  subst hEq
  exact h

/-- A state satisfying `stop` satisfies `wpUntilPred` at every fuel. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_stop {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S} (h : stop s) :
    wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel s := by
  cases fuel with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ _ => exact Or.inl h

/-- A state satisfying `stop` satisfies `execUntilPred` at every fuel. -/
theorem execUntilPred_stop {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    (fuel : Nat) {s : S} (h : stop s) :
    execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault fuel s := by
  cases fuel with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ _ => exact Or.inl h

/-- Single-step introduction for `execUntilPred`. -/
theorem execUntilPred_step {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s s' : S} (hStep : step s = .step s')
    (hNext : execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault fuel s') :
    execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault (fuel + 1) s := by
  refine Or.inr ?_
  change (match step s with
    | .step st' => execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault fuel st'
    | .done out => onDone s out
    | .fault k => onFault s k)
  rw [hStep]
  exact hNext

/-- Single-step introduction for `wpUntilPred` along a deterministic step. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_step {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : match step c₀ s with
      | .step st' => wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel st'
      | .done out => onDone s out
      | .fault k => onFault s k) :
    wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault (fuel + 1) s := by
  refine wpUntilPred_succ_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨⟨c₀, (hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl⟩, ?_⟩)
  intro c hc
  have hEq : c = c₀ := (hUnique s c).mp hc
  subst hEq
  exact h

/-- Exact equivalence between `wpUntilPred` and deterministic `execUntilPred`.
-/
theorem wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} {s : S},
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel s ↔
      execUntilPred (step c₀) stop onDone onFault fuel s
  | 0, _ => Iff.rfl
  | fuel + 1, s => by
    change (stop s ∨
        ((∃ cInit : C, validChoice s cInit) ∧
          ∀ c : C, validChoice s c →
            match step c s with
            | .step st' =>
              wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel st'
            | .done out => onDone s out
            | .fault k => onFault s k)) ↔
      (stop s ∨
        match step c₀ s with
        | .step st' => execUntilPred (step c₀) stop onDone onFault fuel st'
        | .done out => onDone s out
        | .fault k => onFault s k)
    constructor
    · intro h
      cases h with
      | inl hs => exact Or.inl hs
      | inr hr =>
        refine Or.inr ?_
        have h0 := hr.2 c₀ ((hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl)
        cases hStep : step c₀ s with
        | step st' =>
          rw [hStep] at h0
          exact (wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred hUnique).mp h0
        | done out =>
          rw [hStep] at h0
          exact h0
        | fault k =>
          rw [hStep] at h0
          exact h0
    · intro h
      cases h with
      | inl hs => exact Or.inl hs
      | inr hr =>
        refine Or.inr ⟨⟨c₀, (hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl⟩, fun c hc => ?_⟩
        have hcEq : c = c₀ := (hUnique s c).mp hc
        subst hcEq
        cases hStep : step c s with
        | step st' =>
          rw [hStep] at hr
          exact (wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred hUnique).mpr hr
        | done out =>
          rw [hStep] at hr
          exact hr
        | fault k =>
          rw [hStep] at hr
          exact hr

/-- Lift deterministic `execUntilPred` into `wpUntilPred`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_of_execUntilPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : execUntilPred (step c₀) stop onDone onFault fuel s) :
    wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel s :=
  (wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred hUnique).mpr h

/-- Project `wpUntilPred` onto deterministic `execUntilPred`. -/
theorem execUntilPred_of_wpUntilPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel s) :
    execUntilPred (step c₀) stop onDone onFault fuel s :=
  (wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred hUnique).mp h

/-- Rule of consequence for `wpUntilPred`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_mono {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop₁ stop₂ : S → Prop}
    {onDone₁ onDone₂ : S → Out → Prop}
    {onFault₁ onFault₂ : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    (hStop : ∀ s, stop₁ s → stop₂ s)
    (hDone : ∀ s out, onDone₁ s out → onDone₂ s out)
    (hFault : ∀ s k, onFault₁ s k → onFault₂ s k) :
    ∀ {fuel : Nat} {s : S},
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop₁ onDone₁ onFault₁ fuel s →
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop₂ onDone₂ onFault₂ fuel s
  | 0, s, h => hStop s h
  | fuel + 1, s, h => by
    cases h with
    | inl hs => exact Or.inl (hStop s hs)
    | inr hr =>
      refine Or.inr ⟨hr.1, fun c hc => ?_⟩
      have hc' := hr.2 c hc
      cases hStep : step c s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact wpUntilPred_mono hStop hDone hFault hc'
      | done out =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hDone s out hc'
      | fault k =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hFault s k hc'

/-- Rule of consequence for `execUntilPred`. -/
theorem execUntilPred_mono {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop₁ stop₂ : S → Prop}
    {onDone₁ onDone₂ : S → Out → Prop}
    {onFault₁ onFault₂ : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    (hStop : ∀ s, stop₁ s → stop₂ s)
    (hDone : ∀ s out, onDone₁ s out → onDone₂ s out)
    (hFault : ∀ s k, onFault₁ s k → onFault₂ s k)
    {fuel : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : execUntilPred step stop₁ onDone₁ onFault₁ fuel s) :
    execUntilPred step stop₂ onDone₂ onFault₂ fuel s :=
  (wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
      (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mp
    (wpUntilPred_mono hStop hDone hFault
      ((wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
        (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mpr h))

/-- Fuel weakening `fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂` for `wpUntilPred`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_fuel_mono {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} :
    ∀ {fuel₁ fuel₂ : Nat} {s : S},
      fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂ →
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel₁ s →
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault fuel₂ s
  | 0, _, _, _, h => wpUntilPred_stop h
  | fuel₁ + 1, 0, _, hLe, _ =>
    False.elim (Nat.not_succ_le_zero fuel₁ hLe)
  | fuel₁ + 1, fuel₂ + 1, s, hLe, h => by
    have hLe' : fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂ := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hLe
    cases h with
    | inl hs => exact Or.inl hs
    | inr hr =>
      refine Or.inr ⟨hr.1, fun c hc => ?_⟩
      have hc' := hr.2 c hc
      cases hStep : step c s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact wpUntilPred_fuel_mono hLe' hc'
      | done _ =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hc'
      | fault _ =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hc'

/-- Fuel weakening `fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂` for `execUntilPred`. -/
theorem execUntilPred_fuel_mono {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {fuel₁ fuel₂ : Nat} {s : S} (hLe : fuel₁ ≤ fuel₂)
    (h : execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault fuel₁ s) :
    execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault fuel₂ s :=
  (wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
      (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mp
    (wpUntilPred_fuel_mono hLe
      ((wpUntilPred_iff_execUntilPred (C := Unit) (step := fun _ => step)
        (c₀ := ()) (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)).mpr h))

/-- Sequential composition of `wpUntilPred` checkpoints with budget
`f₂ + f₁`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_bind_rev {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {mid stop : S → Prop}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {f₂ : Nat}
    (hK : ∀ s', mid s' → wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    ∀ {f₁ : Nat} {s : S},
      wpUntilPred validChoice step mid onDone onFault f₁ s →
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault (f₂ + f₁) s
  | 0, s, h =>
    wpUntilPred_fuel_cast (Nat.add_zero f₂).symm (hK s h)
  | f₁ + 1, s, h => by
    cases h with
    | inl hm =>
      exact wpUntilPred_fuel_mono (Nat.le_add_right f₂ (f₁ + 1)) (hK s hm)
    | inr hr =>
      refine wpUntilPred_fuel_cast (Nat.add_assoc f₂ f₁ 1)
        (wpUntilPred_succ_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hr.1, fun c hc => ?_⟩))
      have hc' := hr.2 c hc
      cases hStep : step c s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact wpUntilPred_bind_rev hK hc'
      | done _ =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hc'
      | fault _ =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hc'

/-- Sequential composition of `wpUntilPred` checkpoints with budget
`f₁ + f₂`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_bind {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {mid stop : S → Prop}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {f₁ f₂ : Nat} {s : S}
    (hFirst : wpUntilPred validChoice step mid onDone onFault f₁ s)
    (hK : ∀ s', mid s' → wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault (f₁ + f₂) s :=
  wpUntilPred_fuel_cast (Nat.add_comm f₂ f₁) (wpUntilPred_bind_rev hK hFirst)

/-- Helper for `wpUntilPred_bind_exists` under singleton choice `c₀`. -/
private theorem wpUntilPred_bind_exists_aux {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {mid stop : S → Prop}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    (hK : ∀ s', mid s' →
      ∃ f₂, wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    ∀ {f₁ : Nat} {s : S},
      wpUntilPred validChoice step mid onDone onFault f₁ s →
      ∃ F, wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault F s
  | 0, s, h => hK s h
  | _ + 1, s, h => by
    cases h with
    | inl hm => exact hK s hm
    | inr hr =>
      have h0 := hr.2 c₀ ((hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl)
      cases hStep : step c₀ s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        let ⟨F, hF⟩ := wpUntilPred_bind_exists_aux hUnique hK h0
        refine ⟨F + 1, wpUntilPred_step hUnique ?_⟩
        rw [hStep]
        exact hF
      | done out =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        refine ⟨1, wpUntilPred_step hUnique ?_⟩
        rw [hStep]
        exact h0
      | fault k =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        refine ⟨1, wpUntilPred_step hUnique ?_⟩
        rw [hStep]
        exact h0

/-- Existential sequential composition of `wpUntilPred` checkpoints under
singleton choice `c₀`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_bind_exists {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {mid stop : S → Prop}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop} {s : S}
    (hFirst : ∃ f₁, wpUntilPred validChoice step mid onDone onFault f₁ s)
    (hK : ∀ s', mid s' →
      ∃ f₂, wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    ∃ F, wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault F s := by
  let ⟨_, h1⟩ := hFirst
  exact wpUntilPred_bind_exists_aux hUnique hK h1

/-- Hand a checkpoint proof `wpUntilPred` over to `wpStepPred` with budget
`f₂ + f₁`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred_rev {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {f₂ : Nat}
    (hK : ∀ s', stop s' → wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    ∀ {f₁ : Nat} {s : S},
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₁ s →
      wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault (f₂ + f₁) s
  | 0, s, h => wpStepPred_fuel_cast (Nat.add_zero f₂).symm (hK s h)
  | f₁ + 1, s, h => by
    cases h with
    | inl hs => exact wpStepPred_fuel_mono (Nat.le_add_right f₂ (f₁ + 1)) (hK s hs)
    | inr hr =>
      refine wpStepPred_fuel_cast (Nat.add_assoc f₂ f₁ 1)
        (wpStepPred_succ_iff.mpr ⟨hr.1, fun c hc => ?_⟩)
      have hc' := hr.2 c hc
      cases hStep : step c s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred_rev hK hc'
      | done _ =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hc'
      | fault _ =>
        rw [hStep] at hc'
        exact hc'

/-- Hand a checkpoint proof `wpUntilPred` over to `wpStepPred` with budget
`f₁ + f₂`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {f₁ f₂ : Nat} {s : S}
    (h : wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₁ s)
    (hK : ∀ s', stop s' → wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault (f₁ + f₂) s :=
  wpStepPred_fuel_cast (Nat.add_comm f₂ f₁) (wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred_rev hK h)

private theorem wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred_exists_aux {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    (hK : ∀ s', stop s' →
      ∃ f₂, wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    ∀ {f₁ : Nat} {s : S},
      wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₁ s →
      ∃ F, wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault F s
  | 0, s, h => hK s h
  | _ + 1, s, h => by
    cases h with
    | inl hs => exact hK s hs
    | inr hr =>
      have h0 := hr.2 c₀ ((hUnique s c₀).mpr rfl)
      cases hStep : step c₀ s with
      | step st' =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        let ⟨F, hF⟩ := wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred_exists_aux hUnique hK h0
        refine ⟨F + 1, wpStepPred_step hUnique ?_⟩
        rw [hStep]
        exact hF
      | done out =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        refine ⟨1, wpStepPred_step hUnique ?_⟩
        rw [hStep]
        exact h0
      | fault k =>
        rw [hStep] at h0
        refine ⟨1, wpStepPred_step hUnique ?_⟩
        rw [hStep]
        exact h0

/-- Hand a checkpoint proof `wpUntilPred` over to `wpStepPred` with
existential continuation fuel under singleton choice `c₀`. -/
theorem wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred_exists {S Out C : Type}
    {validChoice : S → C → Prop} {step : C → S → StepResult S Out}
    {c₀ : C} (hUnique : ∀ s c, validChoice s c ↔ c = c₀)
    {stop : S → Prop} {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {s : S}
    (h : ∃ f₁, wpUntilPred validChoice step stop onDone onFault f₁ s)
    (hK : ∀ s', stop s' →
      ∃ f₂, wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault f₂ s') :
    ∃ F, wpStepPred validChoice step onDone onFault F s := by
  let ⟨_, h1⟩ := h
  exact wpUntilPred_to_wpStepPred_exists_aux hUnique hK h1

/-- Deterministic checkpoint handoff to `execStepPred`. -/
theorem execUntilPred_to_execStepPred_rev {S Out : Type}
    {step : S → StepResult S Out} {stop : S → Prop}
    {onDone : S → Out → Prop} {onFault : S → FaultKind → Prop}
    {f₁ f₂ : Nat} {s : S}
    (hK : ∀ s', stop s' → execStepPred step onDone onFault f₂ s')
    (h : execUntilPred step stop onDone onFault f₁ s) :
    execStepPred step onDone onFault (f₂ + f₁) s :=
