private theorem symBoolBranches_wf {b : SymBool} (hb : b.wf = true)
    (slots : List SymSlot) (otherwise : BasicBlockId) :
    ∀ (branches : List (BitVec 128 × BasicBlockId)) (pc : SymBool)
      (out : List (SymBool × SymState)),
      pc.wf = true →
      symBoolBranches pc b slots otherwise branches = some out →
      ∀ p, p ∈ out → p.1.wf = true
  | [], pc, out, hPc, h, p, hp => by
    dsimp only [symBoolBranches] at h
    cases hu : symPathUnsat pc with
    | true => rw [hu] at h; cases h; cases hp
    | false =>
      rw [hu] at h; cases h
      cases hp with
      | head _ => exact hPc
      | tail _ hT => cases hT
  | (caseBits, target) :: rest, pc, out, hPc, h, p, hp => by
    dsimp only [symBoolBranches] at h
    cases hLit : evalConstLitComp .bool (.scalar caseBits) with
    | error _ => rw [hLit] at h; cases h
    | ok v =>
      cases v with
      | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | scalar _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit
      | enumVal _ _ | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ =>
        rw [hLit] at h; cases h
      | bool caseBool =>
        rw [hLit] at h
        dsimp only at h
        have hEqWf : (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b).wf = true := by
          cases caseBool <;> exact hb
        have hNeWf : (if caseBool then SymBool.not b else b).wf = true := by
          cases caseBool <;> exact hb
        have hYesWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hEqWf
        have hNoWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hNeWf
        cases hRest : symBoolBranches (symAndCond pc
            (if caseBool then SymBool.not b else b)) b slots otherwise rest with
        | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
        | some restBs =>
          rw [hRest] at h
          dsimp only at h
          cases hu : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
              (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b)) with
          | true =>
            rw [hu] at h; cases h
            exact symBoolBranches_wf hb slots otherwise rest _ _ hNoWf hRest p hp
          | false =>
            rw [hu] at h; cases h
            cases hp with
            | head _ => exact hYesWf
            | tail _ hT =>
              exact symBoolBranches_wf hb slots otherwise rest _ _ hNoWf hRest p hT

private theorem symBoolBranches_sound {b : SymBool} (hb : b.wf = true)
    (slots : List SymSlot) (otherwise : BasicBlockId) :
    ∀ (branches : List (BitVec 128 × BasicBlockId)) (pc : SymBool)
      (out : List (SymBool × SymState)) (env : SymEnv),
      pc.wf = true → pc.eval env = true →
      symBoolBranches pc b slots otherwise branches = some out →
      ∃ t : BasicBlockId,
        evalBoolSwitchBranches (b.eval env) otherwise branches = .ok t ∧
        ∃ p, p ∈ out ∧ p.1.eval env = true ∧
          p.2 = { block := t, stmt := 0, slots := slots }
  | [], pc, out, env, hPc, hPcEv, h => by
    dsimp only [symBoolBranches] at h
    cases hu : symPathUnsat pc with
    | true =>
      have hFalse := symPathUnsat_sound hPc hu env
      rw [hFalse] at hPcEv
      cases hPcEv
    | false =>
      rw [hu] at h; cases h
      refine ⟨otherwise, rfl, (pc, { block := otherwise, stmt := 0, slots := slots }), ?_, hPcEv, rfl⟩
      exact List.Mem.head _
  | (caseBits, target) :: rest, pc, out, env, hPc, hPcEv, h => by
    dsimp only [symBoolBranches] at h
    cases hLit : evalConstLitComp .bool (.scalar caseBits) with
    | error _ => rw [hLit] at h; cases h
    | ok v =>
      cases v with
      | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | scalar _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit
      | enumVal _ _ | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ =>
        rw [hLit] at h; cases h
      | bool caseBool =>
        rw [hLit] at h
        dsimp only at h
        rw [evalConstLitComp_eq] at hLit
        have hEqWf : (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b).wf = true := by
          cases caseBool <;> exact hb
        have hNeWf : (if caseBool then SymBool.not b else b).wf = true := by
          cases caseBool <;> exact hb
        have hYesWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hEqWf
        have hNoWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hNeWf
        cases hRest : symBoolBranches (symAndCond pc
            (if caseBool then SymBool.not b else b)) b slots otherwise rest with
        | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
        | some restBs =>
          rw [hRest] at h
          dsimp only at h
          cases hMatch : (b.eval env == caseBool) with
          | true =>
            have hYesEv : (symAndCond pc
                (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b)).eval env = true := by
              rw [symAndCond_eval _ _ hPc hEqWf env, hPcEv]
              cases caseBool <;>
                (first | rw [ite_bool_true] | rw [ite_bool_false]) <;>
                cases hBEv : b.eval env <;>
                (first
                 | rfl
                 | (dsimp only [SymBool.eval]; rw [hBEv]; rfl)
                 | (rw [hBEv] at hMatch; cases hMatch))
            have hNotUnsat : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
                (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b)) = false := by
              cases hu : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
                  (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b)) with
              | false => rfl
              | true =>
                have hF := symPathUnsat_sound hYesWf hu env
                rw [hF] at hYesEv; cases hYesEv
            rw [hNotUnsat] at h; cases h
            refine ⟨target, ?_, (symAndCond pc (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b),
                { block := target, stmt := 0, slots := slots }), ?_, hYesEv, rfl⟩
            · rw [evalBoolSwitchBranches_cons_eq _ _ _ _ _ caseBool hLit, hMatch]
              rfl
            · exact List.Mem.head _
          | false =>
            have hNoEv : (symAndCond pc
                (if caseBool then SymBool.not b else b)).eval env = true := by
              rw [symAndCond_eval _ _ hPc hNeWf env, hPcEv]
              cases caseBool <;>
                (first | rw [ite_bool_true] | rw [ite_bool_false]) <;>
                cases hBEv : b.eval env <;>
                (first
                 | rfl
                 | (dsimp only [SymBool.eval]; rw [hBEv]; rfl)
                 | (rw [hBEv] at hMatch; cases hMatch))
            let ⟨t, hSw, p, hpMem, hpEv, hpSt⟩ :=
              symBoolBranches_sound hb slots otherwise rest _ restBs env hNoWf hNoEv hRest
            refine ⟨t, ?_, p, ?_, hpEv, hpSt⟩
            · rw [evalBoolSwitchBranches_cons_eq _ _ _ _ _ caseBool hLit, hMatch]
              exact hSw
            · cases hu : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
                  (if caseBool then b else SymBool.not b)) with
              | true => rw [hu] at h; cases h; exact hpMem
              | false => rw [hu] at h; cases h; exact List.Mem.tail _ hpMem

private theorem symScalarBranches_wf {sc : SymScalar} (hsc : sc.wf = true)
    (slots : List SymSlot) (otherwise : BasicBlockId) :
    ∀ (branches : List (BitVec 128 × BasicBlockId)) (pc : SymBool)
      (out : List (SymBool × SymState)),
      pc.wf = true →
      symScalarBranches pc sc slots otherwise branches = some out →
      ∀ p, p ∈ out → p.1.wf = true
  | [], pc, out, hPc, h, p, hp => by
    dsimp only [symScalarBranches] at h
    cases hu : symPathUnsat pc with
    | true => rw [hu] at h; cases h; cases hp
    | false =>
      rw [hu] at h; cases h
      cases hp with
      | head _ => exact hPc
      | tail _ hT => cases hT
  | (caseBits, target) :: rest, pc, out, hPc, h, p, hp => by
    dsimp only [symScalarBranches] at h
    cases hCb : bv128BeqComp (truncateBitsComp sc.width caseBits) caseBits with
    | false => rw [hCb] at h; cases h
    | true =>
      rw [hCb] at h
      have hLitWf : (SymScalar.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩).wf = true := hCb
      have hCondWf : (SymBool.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)).wf = true := by
        dsimp only [SymBool.wf]
        rw [hsc, hLitWf, intWidthBeqComp_eq, boolBeqComp_eq]
        cases sc.width <;> cases sc.signed <;> rfl
      have hNeCondWf : (SymBool.cmp .ne sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)).wf = true := by
        dsimp only [SymBool.wf]
        rw [hsc, hLitWf, intWidthBeqComp_eq, boolBeqComp_eq]
        cases sc.width <;> cases sc.signed <;> rfl
      have hYesWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hCondWf
      have hNoWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hNeCondWf
      cases hRest : symScalarBranches (symAndCond pc
          (.cmp .ne sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)))
          sc slots otherwise rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some restBs =>
        rw [hRest] at h
        dsimp only at h
        cases hu : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
            (.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩))) with
        | true =>
          rw [hu] at h; cases h
          exact symScalarBranches_wf hsc slots otherwise rest _ _ hNoWf hRest p hp
        | false =>
          rw [hu] at h; cases h
          cases hp with
          | head _ => exact hYesWf
          | tail _ hT =>
            exact symScalarBranches_wf hsc slots otherwise rest _ _ hNoWf hRest p hT

private theorem scalarVal_decode_eq_iff (w : IntWidth) (s : Bool)
    (l r : ScalarVal) (hlW : l.width = w) (hrW : r.width = w)
    (hlS : l.signed = s) (hrS : r.signed = s)
    (hlWf : ScalarVal.wf l = true) (hrWf : ScalarVal.wf r = true) :
    (decodeScalar l == decodeScalar r) = (truncateBits w l.bits == r.bits) := by
  have hTrR : truncateBits w r.bits = r.bits := by
    rw [← hrW]
    exact beq_iff_eq.mp hrWf
  have hTrL : truncateBits w l.bits = l.bits := by
    rw [← hlW]
    exact beq_iff_eq.mp hlWf
  cases hEqBits : l.bits == r.bits with
  | true =>
    have hB : l.bits = r.bits := beq_iff_eq.mp hEqBits
    have hLR : l = r := by
      cases l; cases r
      dsimp only at hlW hrW hlS hrS hB
      subst hlW; subst hrW; subst hlS; subst hrS; subst hB
      rfl
    rw [hLR, int_beq_self_eq_true, hTrR, beq_self_eq_true]
  | false =>
    rw [hTrL, hEqBits]
    cases hDec : decodeScalar l == decodeScalar r with
    | false => rfl
    | true =>
      have hDecEq := int_beq_iff_eq.mp hDec
      have hDl := bvOfInt_decodeScalar l
      have hDr := bvOfInt_decodeScalar r
      rw [hlW] at hDl
      rw [hrW] at hDr
      have hBvEq : BitVec.ofNat w.bitWidth l.bits.toNat =
          BitVec.ofNat w.bitWidth r.bits.toNat := by
        rw [← hDl, ← hDr, hDecEq]
      have hLReq := scalarVal_bits_eq_of_bvOfNat_eq hlW hrW (hlS.trans hrS.symm)
        hlWf hrWf hBvEq
      have hBitsEq : l.bits = r.bits := congrArg ScalarVal.bits hLReq
      rw [hBitsEq, beq_self_eq_true] at hEqBits
      cases hEqBits

private theorem symScalarBranches_sound {sc : SymScalar} (hsc : sc.wf = true)
    (slots : List SymSlot) (otherwise : BasicBlockId) :
    ∀ (branches : List (BitVec 128 × BasicBlockId)) (pc : SymBool)
      (out : List (SymBool × SymState)) (env : SymEnv),
      pc.wf = true → pc.eval env = true →
      symScalarBranches pc sc slots otherwise branches = some out →
      ∃ t : BasicBlockId,
        evalSwitchBranches (sc.eval env).width (sc.eval env).bits otherwise branches =
          .ok t ∧
        ∃ p, p ∈ out ∧ p.1.eval env = true ∧
          p.2 = { block := t, stmt := 0, slots := slots }
  | [], pc, out, env, hPc, hPcEv, h => by
    dsimp only [symScalarBranches] at h
    cases hu : symPathUnsat pc with
    | true =>
      have hF := symPathUnsat_sound hPc hu env
      rw [hF] at hPcEv; cases hPcEv
    | false =>
      rw [hu] at h; cases h
      refine ⟨otherwise, rfl, (pc, { block := otherwise, stmt := 0, slots := slots }),
        List.Mem.head _, hPcEv, rfl⟩
  | (caseBits, target) :: rest, pc, out, env, hPc, hPcEv, h => by
    dsimp only [symScalarBranches] at h
    cases hCb : bv128BeqComp (truncateBitsComp sc.width caseBits) caseBits with
    | false => rw [hCb] at h; cases h
    | true =>
      rw [hCb] at h
      have hLitWf : (SymScalar.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩).wf = true := hCb
      have hTrCase : truncateBits sc.width caseBits = caseBits := by
        rw [bv128BeqComp_eq_beq, truncateBitsComp_eq] at hCb
        exact beq_iff_eq.mp hCb
      have hCaseWf : ScalarVal.wf ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩ = true :=
        beq_iff_eq.mpr hTrCase
      have hM := symScalar_eval_meta env sc hsc
      have hCondWf : (SymBool.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)).wf = true := by
        dsimp only [SymBool.wf]
        rw [hsc, hLitWf, intWidthBeqComp_eq, boolBeqComp_eq]
        cases sc.width <;> cases sc.signed <;> rfl
      have hNeCondWf : (SymBool.cmp .ne sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)).wf = true := by
        dsimp only [SymBool.wf]
        rw [hsc, hLitWf, intWidthBeqComp_eq, boolBeqComp_eq]
        cases sc.width <;> cases sc.signed <;> rfl
      have hYesWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hCondWf
      have hNoWf := symAndCond_wf hPc hNeCondWf
      have hCmpEq :
          (SymBool.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)).eval env =
            (truncateBits sc.width (sc.eval env).bits == caseBits) := by
        dsimp only [SymBool.eval]
        rw [evalBinOpComp_eq,
          evalBinOp_cmp_eq_ne .eq (Or.inl rfl) (sc.eval env)
            ((SymScalar.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩).eval env) hM.1 hM.2.1]
        dsimp only
        rw [symScalar_lit_eval hLitWf]
        exact scalarVal_decode_eq_iff sc.width sc.signed _ _ hM.1 rfl
          hM.2.1 rfl hM.2.2 hCaseWf
      have hCmpNe :
          (SymBool.cmp .ne sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)).eval env =
            !(truncateBits sc.width (sc.eval env).bits == caseBits) := by
        dsimp only [SymBool.eval]
        rw [evalBinOpComp_eq,
          evalBinOp_cmp_eq_ne .ne (Or.inr rfl) (sc.eval env)
            ((SymScalar.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩).eval env) hM.1 hM.2.1]
        dsimp only
        rw [symScalar_lit_eval hLitWf]
        change (decodeScalar (sc.eval env) != decodeScalar ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩) = _
        have hEq := scalarVal_decode_eq_iff sc.width sc.signed _ _ hM.1 rfl
          hM.2.1 rfl hM.2.2 hCaseWf
        exact congrArg not hEq
      cases hRest : symScalarBranches (symAndCond pc
          (.cmp .ne sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)))
          sc slots otherwise rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some restBs =>
        rw [hRest] at h
        dsimp only at h
        cases hArm : truncateBits (sc.eval env).width (sc.eval env).bits == caseBits with
        | true =>
          have hArmSc :
              (truncateBits sc.width (sc.eval env).bits == caseBits) = true := by
            rw [← hM.1]; exact hArm
          have hYesEv : (symAndCond pc
              (.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩))).eval env = true := by
            rw [symAndCond_eval _ _ hPc hCondWf env, hPcEv, hCmpEq, hArmSc]
            rfl
          have hNotUnsat : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
              (.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩))) = false := by
            cases hu : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
                (.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩))) with
            | false => rfl
            | true =>
              have hF := symPathUnsat_sound hYesWf hu env
              rw [hF] at hYesEv; cases hYesEv
          rw [hNotUnsat] at h; cases h
          have hSwCase : truncateBits (sc.eval env).width caseBits = caseBits := by
            rw [hM.1]; exact hTrCase
          refine ⟨target, ?_, (symAndCond pc (.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩)),
              { block := target, stmt := 0, slots := slots }), List.Mem.head _, hYesEv, rfl⟩
          rw [evalSwitchBranches_cons_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ hSwCase, hArm]
          rfl
        | false =>
          have hArmSc :
              (truncateBits sc.width (sc.eval env).bits == caseBits) = false := by
            rw [← hM.1]; exact hArm
          have hNoEv : (symAndCond pc
              (.cmp .ne sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩))).eval env = true := by
            rw [symAndCond_eval _ _ hPc hNeCondWf env, hPcEv, hCmpNe, hArmSc]
            rfl
          let ⟨t, hSw, p, hpMem, hpEv, hpSt⟩ :=
            symScalarBranches_sound hsc slots otherwise rest _ restBs env hNoWf hNoEv hRest
          have hSwCase : truncateBits (sc.eval env).width caseBits = caseBits := by
            rw [hM.1]; exact hTrCase
          refine ⟨t, ?_, p, ?_, hpEv, hpSt⟩
          · rw [evalSwitchBranches_cons_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ hSwCase, hArm]
            exact hSw
          · cases hu : symPathUnsat (symAndCond pc
                (.cmp .eq sc (.lit ⟨sc.width, sc.signed, caseBits⟩))) with
            | true => rw [hu] at h; cases h; exact hpMem
            | false => rw [hu] at h; cases h; exact List.Mem.tail _ hpMem

/-- Single-step branched symbolic execution. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def symStepBranched (body : Body) (pc : SymBool) (s : SymState) :
    SymBranchStep :=
  if symPathUnsat pc then .next []
  else
    match compGetElem? body.basicBlocks s.block with
    | none => .stuck
    | some bb =>
      match compGetElem? bb.statements s.stmt with
      | some stmt =>
        match symStatement body s stmt with
        | some s' => .next [(pc, s')]
        | none => .stuck
      | none =>
        if !Nat.beq s.stmt bb.statements.length then .stuck
        else
          match bb.terminator with
          | .switchInt discr targets =>
            match symPrim body.locals s.slots discr with
            | some (.bool b, ls) =>
              if b.wf then
                match symBoolBranches pc b ls targets.otherwise targets.branches with
                | some bs => .next bs
                | none => .stuck
              else .stuck
            | some (.scalar sc, ls) =>
              if sc.wf then
                match symScalarBranches pc sc ls targets.otherwise targets.branches with
                | some bs => .next bs
                | none => .stuck
              else .stuck
            | _ =>
              match symTerminator body bb s with
              | .step s' => .next [(pc, s')]
              | .ret v => .done pc v
              | .stuck => .stuck
          | _ =>
            match symTerminator body bb s with
            | .step s' => .next [(pc, s')]
            | .ret v => .done pc v
            | .stuck => .stuck

theorem symStepBranched_wf {body : Body} {pc : SymBool} {s : SymState}
    {bs : List (SymBool × SymState)} (hPc : pc.wf = true)
    (h : symStepBranched body pc s = .next bs) :
    (∀ p, p ∈ bs → p.1.wf = true) := by
  unfold symStepBranched at h
  cases hu : symPathUnsat pc with
  | true =>
    rw [hu] at h; cases h
    intro p hp; cases hp
  | false =>
    rw [hu, ite_prop_false (by decide)] at h
    cases hb : compGetElem? body.basicBlocks s.block with
    | none => rw [hb] at h; cases h
    | some bb =>
      rw [hb] at h
      dsimp only at h
      cases hSt : compGetElem? bb.statements s.stmt with
      | some stmt =>
        rw [hSt] at h
        dsimp only at h
        cases hSim : symStatement body s stmt with
        | none => rw [hSim] at h; cases h
        | some s' =>
          rw [hSim] at h; cases h
          intro p hp
          cases hp with
          | head _ => exact hPc
          | tail _ hT => cases hT
      | none =>
        rw [hSt] at h
        cases hLen : !Nat.beq s.stmt bb.statements.length with
        | true => rw [hLen, ite_prop_true rfl] at h; cases h
        | false =>
          rw [hLen, ite_prop_false (by decide)] at h
          cases hT : bb.terminator with
          | goto _ | return_ | unreachable | unwindResume
          | assert _ _ _ _ _ | call _ _ _ _ _ | coreCall _ _ _ _ _
          | unsupported =>
            rw [hT] at h
            cases hTerm : symTerminator body bb s with
            | ret _ | stuck => rw [hTerm] at h; cases h
            | step s' =>
              rw [hTerm] at h; cases h
              intro p hp
              cases hp with
              | head _ => exact hPc
              | tail _ hT2 => cases hT2
          | switchInt discr targets =>
            rw [hT] at h
            dsimp only at h
            cases hPr : symPrim body.locals s.slots discr with
            | none =>
              rw [hPr] at h
              cases hTerm : symTerminator body bb s with
              | ret _ | stuck => rw [hTerm] at h; cases h
              | step s' =>
                rw [hTerm] at h; cases h
                intro p hp
                cases hp with
                | head _ => exact hPc
                | tail _ hT2 => cases hT2
            | some pair =>
              cases pair with
              | mk dv ls =>
                rw [hPr] at h
                cases dv with
                | conc _ | pair _ _ =>
                  cases hTerm : symTerminator body bb s with
                  | ret _ | stuck => rw [hTerm] at h; cases h
                  | step s' =>
                    rw [hTerm] at h; cases h
                    intro p hp
                    cases hp with
                    | head _ => exact hPc
                    | tail _ hT2 => cases hT2
                | bool b =>
                  dsimp only at h
                  cases hWf : b.wf with
                  | false => rw [hWf] at h; cases h
                  | true =>
                    rw [hWf] at h
                    cases hBr : symBoolBranches pc b ls targets.otherwise targets.branches with
                    | none => rw [hBr] at h; cases h
                    | some out =>
                      rw [hBr] at h; cases h
                      exact symBoolBranches_wf hWf ls targets.otherwise
                        targets.branches pc _ hPc hBr
                | scalar sc =>
                  dsimp only at h
                  cases hWf : sc.wf with
                  | false => rw [hWf] at h; cases h
                  | true =>
                    rw [hWf] at h
                    cases hBr : symScalarBranches pc sc ls targets.otherwise targets.branches with
                    | none => rw [hBr] at h; cases h
                    | some out =>
                      rw [hBr] at h; cases h
                      exact symScalarBranches_wf hWf ls targets.otherwise
                        targets.branches pc _ hPc hBr

private theorem symStep_sound_general {body : Body} {bb : BasicBlock}
    {s : SymState} {env : SymEnv}
    (hb : compGetElem? body.basicBlocks s.block = some bb)
    (hSt : compGetElem? bb.statements s.stmt = none)
    (hLen : Nat.beq s.stmt bb.statements.length = true)
    (res : StepResult State TerminalOut)
    (hTerm : evalTerminator body bb (s.toFrame env) entryMemory ⟨[]⟩ = res) :
    evalStep (bodyProg body) 0 (s.toState env) = res := by
  dsimp only [evalStep, bodyProg, SymState.toState]
  change (match some body with
      | none => StepResult.fault FaultKind.unsupported
      | some body =>
        match Trusted.MirSemantics.getElem? body.basicBlocks s.block with
        | none => StepResult.fault FaultKind.unsupported
        | some bb =>
          match Trusted.MirSemantics.getElem? bb.statements s.stmt with
          | some stmt => evalStatement body (s.toFrame env) entryMemory ⟨[]⟩ stmt
          | none =>
            if Nat.beq s.stmt bb.statements.length then
              evalTerminator body bb (s.toFrame env) entryMemory ⟨[]⟩
            else StepResult.fault FaultKind.unsupported) = res
  dsimp only
  rw [← compGetElem?_eq, hb]
  dsimp only
  rw [← compGetElem?_eq, hSt]
  dsimp only
  rw [hLen, ite_prop_true rfl]
  exact hTerm

theorem symStepBranched_sound {body : Body} {pc : SymBool} {s : SymState}
    (hPc : pc.wf = true) (env : SymEnv) (hPcEv : pc.eval env = true) :
    (∀ pc' out, symStepBranched body pc s = .done pc' out →
      pc'.eval env = true ∧
        evalStep (bodyProg body) 0 (s.toState env) =
          .done (.returned ⟨out.eval env, ⟨[]⟩⟩)) ∧
    (∀ bs, symStepBranched body pc s = .next bs →
      ∃ p, p ∈ bs ∧ p.1.eval env = true ∧
        evalStep (bodyProg body) 0 (s.toState env) = .step (p.2.toState env)) := by
  unfold symStepBranched
  cases hu : symPathUnsat pc with
  | true =>
    have hF := symPathUnsat_sound hPc hu env
    rw [hF] at hPcEv; cases hPcEv
  | false =>
    rw [ite_prop_false (by decide)]
    cases hb : compGetElem? body.basicBlocks s.block with
    | none => exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
    | some bb =>
      dsimp only
      cases hSt : compGetElem? bb.statements s.stmt with
      | some stmt =>
        dsimp only
        cases hSim : symStatement body s stmt with
        | none => exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
        | some s' =>
          refine ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun bs h => ?_⟩
          cases h
          refine ⟨(pc, s'), List.Mem.head _, hPcEv, ?_⟩
          dsimp only [evalStep, bodyProg, SymState.toState,
            Trusted.MirSemantics.getElem?]
          rw [← compGetElem?_eq, hb]
          dsimp only
          rw [← compGetElem?_eq, hSt]
          exact symStatement_sound hSim env
      | none =>
        dsimp only
        cases hLen : Nat.beq s.stmt bb.statements.length with
        | false =>
          rw [Bool.not_false, ite_prop_true rfl]
          exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
        | true =>
          rw [Bool.not_true, ite_prop_false (by decide)]
          cases hT : bb.terminator with
          | goto _ | return_ | unreachable | unwindResume
          | assert _ _ _ _ _ | call _ _ _ _ _ | coreCall _ _ _ _ _
          | unsupported =>
            dsimp only
            cases hTerm : symTerminator body bb s with
            | stuck => exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
            | ret v =>
              refine ⟨fun pc' out h => ?_, (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
              cases h
              exact ⟨hPcEv, symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _
                (symTerminator_ret hTerm env)⟩
            | step s' =>
              refine ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun bs h => ?_⟩
              cases h
              exact ⟨(pc, s'), List.Mem.head _, hPcEv,
                symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _ (symTerminator_step hTerm env)⟩
          | switchInt discr targets =>
            dsimp only
            cases hPr : symPrim body.locals s.slots discr with
            | none =>
              dsimp only
              cases hTerm : symTerminator body bb s with
              | stuck => exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
              | ret v =>
                refine ⟨fun pc' out h => ?_, (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
                cases h
                exact ⟨hPcEv, symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _
                  (symTerminator_ret hTerm env)⟩
              | step s' =>
                refine ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun bs h => ?_⟩
                cases h
                exact ⟨(pc, s'), List.Mem.head _, hPcEv,
                  symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _ (symTerminator_step hTerm env)⟩
            | some pair =>
              cases pair with
              | mk dv ls =>
                cases dv with
                | conc _ | pair _ _ =>
                  dsimp only
                  cases hTerm : symTerminator body bb s with
                  | stuck => exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
                  | ret v =>
                    refine ⟨fun pc' out h => ?_, (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
                    cases h
                    exact ⟨hPcEv, symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _
                      (symTerminator_ret hTerm env)⟩
                  | step s' =>
                    refine ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun bs h => ?_⟩
                    cases h
                    exact ⟨(pc, s'), List.Mem.head _, hPcEv,
                      symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _ (symTerminator_step hTerm env)⟩
                | bool b =>
                  dsimp only
                  cases hWf : b.wf with
                  | false =>
                    rw [ite_prop_false (by decide)]
                    exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
                  | true =>
                    rw [ite_prop_true rfl]
                    cases hBr : symBoolBranches pc b ls targets.otherwise targets.branches with
                    | none => exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
                    | some out =>
                      refine ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun bs h => ?_⟩
                      cases h
                      let ⟨t, hSw, p, hpMem, hpEv, hpSt⟩ :=
                        symBoolBranches_sound hWf ls targets.otherwise
                          targets.branches pc out env hPc hPcEv hBr
                      refine ⟨p, hpMem, hpEv, ?_⟩
                      rw [hpSt]
                      refine symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _ ?_
                      dsimp only [evalTerminator, SymState.toFrame]
                      rw [hT]
                      dsimp only
                      rw [symPrim_sound hPr env]
                      dsimp only [SymVal.eval]
                      rw [hSw]
                      rfl
                | scalar sc =>
                  dsimp only
                  cases hWf : sc.wf with
                  | false =>
                    rw [ite_prop_false (by decide)]
                    exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
                  | true =>
                    rw [ite_prop_true rfl]
                    cases hBr : symScalarBranches pc sc ls targets.otherwise targets.branches with
                    | none => exact ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), (fun _ h => by cases h)⟩
                    | some out =>
                      refine ⟨(fun _ _ h => by cases h), fun bs h => ?_⟩
                      cases h
                      let ⟨t, hSw, p, hpMem, hpEv, hpSt⟩ :=
                        symScalarBranches_sound hWf ls targets.otherwise
                          targets.branches pc out env hPc hPcEv hBr
                      refine ⟨p, hpMem, hpEv, ?_⟩
                      rw [hpSt]
                      refine symStep_sound_general hb hSt hLen _ ?_
                      dsimp only [evalTerminator, SymState.toFrame]
                      rw [hT]
                      dsimp only
                      rw [symPrim_sound hPr env]
                      dsimp only [SymVal.eval]
                      rw [hSw]
                      rfl

/-- Worklist `(donePaths, activePaths)` for branched symbolic execution. -/
abbrev SymWorkState := List (SymBool × SymVal) × List (SymBool × SymState)

/-- Advance all active symbolic states by one step. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def symStepAll (body : Body) (doneAcc : List (SymBool × SymVal)) :
    List (SymBool × SymState) → Option SymWorkState
  | [] => some (doneAcc, [])
  | (pc, s) :: rest =>
    match symStepBranched body pc s with
    | .stuck => none
    | .done pc' v =>
      match symStepAll body ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) rest with
      | none => none
      | some (d', a') => some (d', a')
    | .next bs =>
      match symStepAll body doneAcc rest with
      | none => none
      | some (d', a') => some (d', bs ++ a')

/-- Fuel-bounded branched symbolic runner via `@Nat.rec` (`0` `._unsafe_rec`).
-/
@[expose] noncomputable def symRunPathsAux (body : Body) (fuel : Nat) (st : SymWorkState) :
    Option (List (SymBool × SymVal)) :=
  @Nat.rec (fun _ => SymWorkState → Option (List (SymBool × SymVal)))
    (fun cur => if cur.2.isEmpty then some cur.1 else none)
    (fun _ ih cur =>
      if cur.2.isEmpty then some cur.1
      else
        match symStepAll body cur.1 cur.2 with
        | none => none
        | some cur' => ih cur')
    fuel st

/-- Run all feasible symbolic paths of `body` from `(pc, s)` up to `fuel`
steps, failing closed (`none`) if any path gets stuck or runs out of fuel. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def symRunPaths (body : Body) (fuel : Nat) (pc : SymBool)
    (s : SymState) : Option (List (SymBool × SymVal)) :=
  symRunPathsAux body fuel ([], [(pc, s)])

private theorem list_mem_append {α : Type} {x : α} :
    ∀ {xs ys : List α}, x ∈ xs ++ ys ↔ x ∈ xs ∨ x ∈ ys
  | [], _ys =>
    ⟨fun h => Or.inr h, fun h => match h with | Or.inr hy => hy⟩
  | _ :: xs, ys =>
    ⟨fun h =>
      match h with
      | .head _ => Or.inl (List.Mem.head _)
      | .tail _ ht =>
        match (list_mem_append (xs := xs) (ys := ys)).mp ht with
        | Or.inl h1 => Or.inl (List.Mem.tail _ h1)
        | Or.inr h2 => Or.inr h2,
     fun h =>
      match h with
      | Or.inl (.head _) => List.Mem.head _
      | Or.inl (.tail _ ht) =>
        List.Mem.tail _ ((list_mem_append (xs := xs) (ys := ys)).mpr (Or.inl ht))
      | Or.inr hy =>
        List.Mem.tail _ ((list_mem_append (xs := xs) (ys := ys)).mpr (Or.inr hy))⟩

private theorem symStepAll_wf (body : Body) :
    ∀ (active : List (SymBool × SymState)) (doneAcc : List (SymBool × SymVal))
      (res : SymWorkState),
      (∀ p, p ∈ active → p.1.wf = true) →
      symStepAll body doneAcc active = some res →
      ∀ p, p ∈ res.2 → p.1.wf = true
  | [], doneAcc, res, _, h => by
    cases h
    intro p hp; cases hp
  | (pc, s) :: rest, doneAcc, res, hWf, h => by
    dsimp only [symStepAll] at h
    have hPcWf := hWf (pc, s) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hRestWf : ∀ p, p ∈ rest → p.1.wf = true :=
      fun p hp => hWf p (List.Mem.tail _ hp)
    cases hStep : symStepBranched body pc s with
    | stuck => rw [hStep] at h; cases h
    | done pc' v =>
      rw [hStep] at h
      dsimp only at h
      cases hRest : symStepAll body ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some p =>
        cases p with
        | mk d' a' =>
          rw [hRest] at h; cases h
          exact symStepAll_wf body rest ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) (d', a') hRestWf hRest
    | next bs =>
      rw [hStep] at h
      cases hRest : symStepAll body doneAcc rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some p =>
        cases p with
        | mk d' a' =>
          rw [hRest] at h; cases h
          intro q hq
          cases list_mem_append.mp hq with
          | inl hb => exact symStepBranched_wf hPcWf hStep q hb
          | inr ha => exact symStepAll_wf body rest doneAcc (d', a') hRestWf hRest q ha

private theorem symStepAll_preserves_done (body : Body) :
    ∀ (active : List (SymBool × SymState)) (doneAcc : List (SymBool × SymVal))
      (res : SymWorkState) (x : SymBool × SymVal),
      symStepAll body doneAcc active = some res →
      x ∈ doneAcc → x ∈ res.1
  | [], doneAcc, res, x, h, hx => by cases h; exact hx
  | (pc, s) :: rest, doneAcc, res, x, h, hx => by
    dsimp only [symStepAll] at h
    cases hStep : symStepBranched body pc s with
    | stuck => rw [hStep] at h; cases h
    | done pc' v =>
      rw [hStep] at h
      dsimp only at h
      cases hRest : symStepAll body ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some p =>
        cases p with
        | mk d' a' =>
          rw [hRest] at h; cases h
          exact symStepAll_preserves_done body rest ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) (d', a') x
            hRest (List.Mem.tail _ hx)
    | next bs =>
      rw [hStep] at h
      cases hRest : symStepAll body doneAcc rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some p =>
        cases p with
        | mk d' a' =>
          rw [hRest] at h; cases h
          exact symStepAll_preserves_done body rest doneAcc (d', a') x hRest hx

private theorem symStepAll_sound (body : Body) (env : SymEnv) :
    ∀ (active : List (SymBool × SymState)) (doneAcc : List (SymBool × SymVal))
      (res : SymWorkState) (p : SymBool × SymState),
      (∀ q, q ∈ active → q.1.wf = true) →
      symStepAll body doneAcc active = some res →
      p ∈ active → p.1.eval env = true →
      (∃ out : SymVal, ∃ pc' : SymBool,
        (pc', out) ∈ res.1 ∧ pc'.eval env = true ∧
        evalStep (bodyProg body) 0 (p.2.toState env) =
          .done (.returned ⟨out.eval env, ⟨[]⟩⟩)) ∨
      (∃ q, q ∈ res.2 ∧ q.1.eval env = true ∧
        evalStep (bodyProg body) 0 (p.2.toState env) = .step (q.2.toState env))
  | [], _, _, _, _, _, hp, _ => by cases hp
  | (pc, s) :: rest, doneAcc, res, p, hWf, h, hpMem, hpEv => by
    dsimp only [symStepAll] at h
    have hPcWf := hWf (pc, s) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hRestWf : ∀ q, q ∈ rest → q.1.wf = true :=
      fun q hq => hWf q (List.Mem.tail _ hq)
    cases hStep : symStepBranched body pc s with
    | stuck => rw [hStep] at h; cases h
    | done pc' v =>
      rw [hStep] at h
      dsimp only at h
      cases hRest : symStepAll body ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some pRes =>
        cases pRes with
        | mk d' a' =>
          rw [hRest] at h; cases h
          cases hpMem with
          | head _ =>
            have ⟨hPc'Ev, hEv⟩ :=
              (symStepBranched_sound hPcWf env hpEv).1 pc' v hStep
            exact Or.inl ⟨v, pc',
              symStepAll_preserves_done body rest ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) (d', a')
                (pc', v) hRest (List.Mem.head _), hPc'Ev, hEv⟩
          | tail _ hpR =>
            exact symStepAll_sound body env rest ((pc', v) :: doneAcc) (d', a') p
              hRestWf hRest hpR hpEv
    | next bs =>
      rw [hStep] at h
      dsimp only at h
      cases hRest : symStepAll body doneAcc rest with
      | none => rw [hRest] at h; cases h
      | some pRes =>
        cases pRes with
        | mk d' a' =>
          rw [hRest] at h; cases h
          cases hpMem with
          | head _ =>
            let ⟨q, hqMem, hqEv, hEv⟩ :=
              (symStepBranched_sound hPcWf env hpEv).2 bs hStep
            exact Or.inr ⟨q, list_mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hqMem), hqEv, hEv⟩
          | tail _ hpR =>
            cases symStepAll_sound body env rest doneAcc (d', a') p
                hRestWf hRest hpR hpEv with
            | inl hl => exact Or.inl hl
            | inr hr =>
              let ⟨q, hqMem, hqEv, hEv⟩ := hr
              exact Or.inr ⟨q, list_mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hqMem), hqEv, hEv⟩

private theorem symRunPathsAux_preserves_done (body : Body) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (st : SymWorkState) (out : List (SymBool × SymVal))
      (x : SymBool × SymVal),
      symRunPathsAux body fuel st = some out →
      x ∈ st.1 → x ∈ out
  | 0, st, out, x, h, hx => by
    change (if st.2.isEmpty then some st.1 else none) = some out at h
    cases he : st.2.isEmpty with
    | false => rw [he] at h; cases h
    | true => rw [he] at h; cases h; exact hx
  | fuel + 1, st, out, x, h, hx => by
    change (if st.2.isEmpty then some st.1
      else match symStepAll body st.1 st.2 with
        | none => none
        | some st' => symRunPathsAux body fuel st') = some out at h
    cases he : st.2.isEmpty with
    | true => rw [he] at h; cases h; exact hx
    | false =>
      rw [he] at h
      cases hStep : symStepAll body st.1 st.2 with
      | none => rw [hStep] at h; cases h
      | some st' =>
        rw [hStep] at h
        exact symRunPathsAux_preserves_done body fuel st' out x h
          (symStepAll_preserves_done body st.2 st.1 st' x hStep hx)

private theorem symRunPathsAux_sound (body : Body) (env : SymEnv) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (st : SymWorkState) (out : List (SymBool × SymVal))
      (p : SymBool × SymState),
      (∀ q, q ∈ st.2 → q.1.wf = true) →
      symRunPathsAux body fuel st = some out →
      p ∈ st.2 → p.1.eval env = true →
      ∃ res, res ∈ out ∧ res.1.eval env = true ∧
        Executes body (p.2.toState env) (res.2.eval env)
  | 0, st, out, p, _, h, hp, _ => by
    change (if st.2.isEmpty then some st.1 else none) = some out at h
    cases he : st.2.isEmpty with
    | false => rw [he] at h; cases h
    | true =>
      cases st with
      | mk d a =>
        cases a with
        | nil => cases hp
        | cons _ _ => cases he
  | fuel + 1, st, out, p, hWf, h, hpMem, hpEv => by
    change (if st.2.isEmpty then some st.1
      else match symStepAll body st.1 st.2 with
        | none => none
        | some st' => symRunPathsAux body fuel st') = some out at h
    cases he : st.2.isEmpty with
    | true =>
      cases st with
      | mk d a =>
        cases a with
        | nil => cases hpMem
        | cons _ _ => cases he
    | false =>
      rw [he] at h
      cases hStep : symStepAll body st.1 st.2 with
      | none => rw [hStep] at h; cases h
      | some st' =>
        rw [hStep] at h
        cases symStepAll_sound body env st.2 st.1 st' p hWf hStep hpMem hpEv with
        | inl hd =>
          let ⟨v, pc', hMem', hEv', hRet⟩ := hd
          exact ⟨(pc', v),
            symRunPathsAux_preserves_done body fuel st' out (pc', v) h hMem',
            hEv', .ret hRet⟩
        | inr hn =>
          let ⟨q, hqMem, hqEv, hStepQ⟩ := hn
          have hWf' := symStepAll_wf body st.2 st.1 st' hWf hStep
          let ⟨res, hResMem, hResEv, hExec⟩ :=
            symRunPathsAux_sound body env fuel st' out q hWf' h hqMem hqEv
          exact ⟨res, hResMem, hResEv, .next hStepQ hExec⟩

/-- Branched symbolic execution adequacy: if `symRunPaths body fuel pc s = some
paths`, then every `env` satisfying `pc` picks a concrete path `(pc', out) ∈
paths` executing `body` cleanly from `s.toState env` to `out.eval env`. -/
theorem symRunPaths_sound {body : Body} {fuel : Nat} {pc : SymBool}
    {s : SymState} {paths : List (SymBool × SymVal)}
    (hPc : pc.wf = true)
    (h : symRunPaths body fuel pc s = some paths)
    (env : SymEnv) (hEv : pc.eval env = true) :
    ∃ res, res ∈ paths ∧ res.1.eval env = true ∧
      Executes body (s.toState env) (res.2.eval env) :=
  symRunPathsAux_sound body env fuel ([], [(pc, s)]) paths (pc, s)
    (fun q hq => by
      cases hq with
      | head _ => exact hPc
      | tail _ hT => cases hT)
    h (List.Mem.head _) hEv

/-- Derive `BodyVerified` from a branched symbolic execution run across all
covered entry arguments. -/
theorem bodyVerified_of_symRunPaths {p : Program} {defId : DefId} {body : Body}
    {fuel : Nat} {argsTemplate : List SymVal}
    {paths : List (SymBool × SymVal)}
    (hBody : Trusted.MirSemantics.getElem? p.bodies defId = some body)
    (hAdm : BodyStaticAdmitted p body = true)
    (hRun : symRunPaths body fuel (.lit true) (symEntry body argsTemplate) =
      some paths)
    (hCover : ∀ args : List Val, ValidEntryArgs body args →
      (body.isUnsafe = true → True) →
      ∃ env : SymEnv, argsTemplate.map (SymVal.eval env) = args) :
    BodyVerified p defId body (fun _ => True) := by
  refine bodyVerified_of_safe hBody hAdm (fun args valid _ => ?_)
  let ⟨env, hMap⟩ := hCover args valid (fun _ => True.intro)
  let ⟨res, _, _, hExec⟩ := symRunPaths_sound rfl hRun env rfl
  rw [symEntry_toState, hMap] at hExec
  exact executes_safe hExec

/-! ## Part V: Self-Contained Kernel-Checked Canaries -/

@[expose] noncomputable def canaryBodyArithBvLin : Body :=
  { identity := "canary::bvlin_arith_branch"
    isUnsafe := false
    argumentCount := 2
    locals := [.int .i64 false, .int .i64 false, .int .i64 false,
               .int .i64 false, .int .i64 false, .bool]
    basicBlocks :=
      [ { statements :=
            [ .assign { localId := 3, projection := [] }
                (.binaryOp .add (.copy { localId := 1, projection := [] })
                  (.constant { ty := .int .i64 false, lit := .scalar 8 })),
              .assign { localId := 4, projection := [] }
                (.binaryOp .add (.copy { localId := 1, projection := [] })
                  (.constant { ty := .int .i64 false, lit := .scalar 16 })),
              .assign { localId := 5, projection := [] }
                (.binaryOp .eq (.copy { localId := 3, projection := [] })
                  (.copy { localId := 4, projection := [] })) ]
          terminator := .switchInt (.move { localId := 5, projection := [] })
            { branches := [(1, 1)], otherwise := 2 }
          cleanup := false },
        { statements := []
          terminator := .unreachable
          cleanup := false },
        { statements :=
            [ .assign { localId := 0, projection := [] }
                (.binaryOp .sub (.copy { localId := 3, projection := [] })
                  (.copy { localId := 2, projection := [] })) ]
          terminator := .return_
          cleanup := false } ] }

/-- Kernel-checked multi-variable `BvLin` symbolic canary (`rfl`, `["propext"]`
only): `x + 8 == x + 16` is statically refuted by `BvLin` in `symStep` so the
`.unreachable` arm is eliminated and `(x + 8) - y` is returned cleanly. -/
theorem symExec_multiVar_bvLin_canary :
    symRun canaryBodyArithBvLin 16
      (symEntry canaryBodyArithBvLin
        [.scalar (.var 0 .i64 false), .scalar (.var 1 .i64 false)]) =
      .ret (.scalar
        (.binOp .sub
          (.binOp .add (.var 0 .i64 false)
            (.lit ⟨.i64, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 8⟩))
          (.var 1 .i64 false))) := rfl

@[expose] noncomputable def canaryBodyBranchCast : Body :=
  { identity := "canary::branch_cast"
    isUnsafe := false
    argumentCount := 2
    locals := [.int .i64 false, .bool, .int .i32 false]
    basicBlocks :=
      [ { statements := []
          terminator := .switchInt (.copy { localId := 1, projection := [] })
            { branches := [(0, 2)], otherwise := 1 }
          cleanup := false },
        { statements :=
            [ .assign { localId := 0, projection := [] }
                (.cast .intToInt (.copy { localId := 2, projection := [] })
                  (.int .i64 false)) ]
          terminator := .return_
          cleanup := false },
        { statements :=
            [ .assign { localId := 0, projection := [] }
                (.use (.constant { ty := .int .i64 false, lit := .scalar 42 })) ]
          terminator := .return_
          cleanup := false } ] }

/-- Kernel-checked branched symbolic execution canary (`rfl`, `["propext"]`
only): exercises symbolic boolean `switchInt` + `u32 as u64` cast across all
paths and lifts directly to `Executes`. -/
theorem symExec_branch_and_cast_canary (flag : Bool) (n : BitVec 32) :
    let args := [.bool flag, .scalar ⟨.i32, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat⟩]
    Executes canaryBodyBranchCast
      (mkState 0 0 (initLocalsLoop canaryBodyBranchCast args 0
        canaryBodyBranchCast.locals))
      (if flag then .scalar ⟨.i64, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat⟩
       else .scalar ⟨.i64, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 42⟩) := by
  let env : SymEnv := fun i =>
    if Nat.beq i 0 then .bool flag
    else .scalar ⟨.i32, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat⟩
  have hMod128 : Nat.mod n.toNat (Nat.pow 2 128) = n.toNat :=
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.lt_trans n.isLt (by decide))
  have hTrunc32 :
      truncateBitsComp .i32 (BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat) =
        BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat :=
    truncateBitsComp_bitVec_of_lt n (by decide)
  have hTrunc64 :
      truncateBitsComp .i64 (BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat) =
        BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat :=
    truncateBitsComp_bitVec_of_lt n (by decide)
  have hEq0 : Nat.beq 0 0 = true := rfl
  have hEq1 : Nat.beq 1 0 = false := rfl
  have hArgs :
      ([.bool (.var 0), .scalar (.var 1 .i32 false)] : List SymVal).map
          (SymVal.eval env) =
        [.bool flag, .scalar ⟨.i32, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat⟩] := by
    dsimp only [List.map, SymVal.eval, SymBool.eval, SymScalar.eval, env]
    rw [hEq0, hEq1, ite_bool_true, ite_bool_false]
    dsimp only
    rw [hTrunc32]
  have hPaths :
      symRunPaths canaryBodyBranchCast 16 (.lit true)
        (symEntry canaryBodyBranchCast
          [.bool (.var 0), .scalar (.var 1 .i32 false)]) =
        some [(.var 0, .scalar (.cast .i64 false (.var 1 .i32 false))),
              (.not (.var 0), .conc (.scalar ⟨.i64, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 42⟩))] := rfl
  let ⟨res, hMem, hResEv, hExec⟩ := symRunPaths_sound rfl hPaths env rfl
  rw [symEntry_toState, hArgs] at hExec
  cases hMem with
  | head _ =>
    dsimp only [SymBool.eval, env] at hResEv
    cases flag with
    | false => cases hResEv
    | true =>
      dsimp only [SymVal.eval, SymScalar.eval, evalIntToIntCastComp,
        intLikeBitsComp, env] at hExec
      rw [hEq1, ite_bool_false] at hExec
      dsimp only at hExec
      rw [ite_bool_false] at hExec
      dsimp only at hExec
      rw [hTrunc32, hTrunc32] at hExec
      have hToNat : (BitVec.ofNat 128 n.toNat).toNat = n.toNat := by
        rw [bv_toNat_ofNat, hMod128]
      rw [hToNat, hTrunc64] at hExec
      rw [ite_bool_true]
      exact hExec
  | tail _ hTail =>
    cases hTail with
    | head _ =>
      dsimp only [SymBool.eval, env] at hResEv
      cases flag with
      | true => cases hResEv
      | false =>
        rw [ite_bool_false]
        exact hExec
    | tail _ hNil => cases hNil

end Anneal.MirSymExec

/-!
# Bit-Level Symbolic Predicate Companion (`Anneal.MirSymExec.Bits`)

Pass-1-portable bit-source symbolic checker over `SymScalar` (`0`
`Classical.choice`, `0` `._unsafe_rec`; definitions are `noncomputable` only
to suppress compiler `._unsafe_rec` auxiliaries), separated from
`Anneal.MirSymExec` so the core symbolic executor keeps its strict
`["propext"]`-only axiom ceiling while bit-level proofs (`BitSrc`,
`SymScalar.bitsAre`, `SymScalar.wordBitsAre`) reuse `Anneal.BitVec`
(`["propext", "Quot.sound"]`).
-/

/-- Expected symbolic origin of a single bit in a `SymScalar`. -/
inductive BitSrc where
  | zero
  | one
  | varBit (id idx : Nat)

/-- Shorthand for bit `idx` of symbolic argument `0`. -/
abbrev BitSrc.input (idx : Nat) : BitSrc := .varBit 0 idx

/-- Total boolean equality on `BitSrc`. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def BitSrc.beq : BitSrc → BitSrc → Bool
  | .zero, .zero => true
  | .one, .one => true
  | .varBit i1 k1, .varBit i2 k2 => Nat.beq i1 i2 && Nat.beq k1 k2
  | _, _ => false

theorem BitSrc.eq_of_beq : ∀ {a b : BitSrc}, a.beq b = true → a = b
  | .zero, .zero, _ => rfl
  | .one, .one, _ => rfl
  | .varBit i1 k1, .varBit i2 k2, h => by
    dsimp only [BitSrc.beq] at h
    have hi := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_left h)
    have hk := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_right h)
    rw [hi, hk]
  | .zero, .one, h | .zero, .varBit _ _, h
  | .one, .zero, h | .one, .varBit _ _, h
  | .varBit _ _, .zero, h | .varBit _ _, .one, h => by cases h

/-- Bit `b` agrees with symbolic origin `src` under valuation `env`. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def BitSrc.Agrees (env : SymEnv) : BitSrc → Bool → Prop
  | .zero, b => b = false
  | .one, b => b = true
  | .varBit id idx, b =>
    b = match env id with
        | .scalar sv => Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD sv.bits idx
        | _ => false

/-- Convenience valuation binding symbolic variable `0` to a `BitVec 64`. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def wordEnv (x : BitVec 64) : SymEnv :=
  fun _ => .scalar ⟨.i64, false, BitVec.ofNat 128 x.toNat⟩

theorem bitSrc_agrees_wordEnv (x : BitVec 64) (i : Nat) (b : Bool) :
    (BitSrc.input i).Agrees (wordEnv x) b ↔
      (i < 64 → b = Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x i) ∧ (64 ≤ i → b = false) := by
  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees, BitSrc.input, wordEnv]
  have hEq : BitVec.ofNat 128 x.toNat = BitVec.setWidth 128 x := by
    refine bv_eq_of_toNat_eq ?_
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_setWidth]
  rw [hEq, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]
  cases hi64 : Nat.decLt i 64 with
  | isTrue hLt =>
    have hLt128 : i < 128 := Nat.lt_trans hLt (by decide)
    rw [decide_eq_true hLt128, Bool.true_and]
    exact ⟨fun hb => ⟨fun _ => hb, fun hGe => False.elim (Nat.not_le_of_gt hLt hGe)⟩,
      fun h => h.1 hLt⟩
  | isFalse hGe =>
    have hGe' : 64 ≤ i := Nat.le_of_not_lt hGe
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge x hGe', Bool.and_false]
    exact ⟨fun hb => ⟨fun hLt => False.elim (hGe hLt), fun _ => hb⟩,
      fun h => h.2 hGe'⟩

theorem bitSrc_input_wordEnv (x : BitVec 64) (i : Nat) (b : Bool) :
    (BitSrc.input i).Agrees (wordEnv x) b ↔ b = Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x i := by
  have h := bitSrc_agrees_wordEnv x i b
  cases hi : Nat.decLt i 64 with
  | isTrue hLt =>
    exact ⟨fun ha => (h.mp ha).1 hLt,
      fun hb => h.mpr ⟨fun _ => hb, fun hGe => False.elim (Nat.not_le_of_gt hLt hGe)⟩⟩
  | isFalse hGe =>
    have hGe' : 64 ≤ i := Nat.le_of_not_lt hGe
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_ge x hGe']
    exact ⟨fun ha => (h.mp ha).2 hGe',
      fun hb => h.mpr ⟨fun hLt => False.elim (hGe hLt), fun _ => hb⟩⟩

private theorem natBlt_eq_decide (a b : Nat) : Nat.blt a b = decide (a < b) := by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge a b with
  | inl hLt =>
    have hBlt : Nat.blt a b = true := (Iff.of_eq Nat.blt_eq).mpr hLt
    rw [hBlt]
    exact Eq.symm (decide_eq_true hLt)
  | inr hGe =>
    cases hb : Nat.blt a b with
    | false => exact Eq.symm (decide_eq_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hGe))
    | true => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hGe ((Iff.of_eq Nat.blt_eq).mp hb))

private theorem intWidthModulus_eq_pow (w : IntWidth) :
    intWidthModulus w = Nat.pow 2 w.bitWidth := by
  cases w <;> rfl

private theorem intWidth_bitWidth_le_128 (w : IntWidth) : w.bitWidth ≤ 128 := by
  cases w <;> decide

private theorem two_pow_bitWidth_le_128 (w : IntWidth) :
    Nat.pow 2 w.bitWidth ≤ Nat.pow 2 128 := by
  cases w <;> decide

private theorem getLsbD_truncateBitsComp (w : IntWidth) (x : BitVec 128) (i : Nat) :
    Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (truncateBitsComp w x) i =
      (decide (i < 128) && (decide (i < w.bitWidth) && Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD x i)) := by
  have hEq : truncateBitsComp w x =
      BitVec.setWidth 128 (BitVec.setWidth w.bitWidth x) := by
    rw [truncateBitsComp_eq]
    refine bv_eq_of_toNat_eq ?_
    rw [toNat_truncateBits, intWidthModulus_eq_pow,
      Anneal.BitVec.toNat_setWidth 128 (BitVec.setWidth w.bitWidth x),
      Anneal.BitVec.toNat_setWidth w.bitWidth x]
    have hLt : Nat.mod x.toNat (Nat.pow 2 w.bitWidth) < Nat.pow 2 128 :=
      Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mod_lt _ (nat_two_pow_pos w.bitWidth))
        (two_pow_bitWidth_le_128 w)
    exact Eq.symm (nat_mod_eq_of_lt hLt)
  rw [hEq, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_setWidth]

private theorem bnot_true : (!true) = false := rfl

private theorem bool_false_bne (b : Bool) : (false != b) = b := by cases b <;> rfl

private theorem bool_bne_false (b : Bool) : (b != false) = b := by cases b <;> rfl

private theorem bool_bne_self (b : Bool) : (b != b) = false := by cases b <;> rfl

private theorem ite_true_bool {α : Type} (t e : α) :
    (if true = true then t else e) = t :=
  ite_prop_true rfl

private theorem ite_false_bool {α : Type} (t e : α) :
    (if false = true then t else e) = e :=
  ite_prop_false (by decide)

private theorem intWidth_pow128_factor (w : IntWidth) :
    ∃ k : Nat, Nat.pow 2 128 = Nat.pow 2 w.bitWidth * k := by
  cases w with
  | i8 => exact ⟨Nat.pow 2 120, by decide⟩
  | i16 => exact ⟨Nat.pow 2 112, by decide⟩
  | i32 => exact ⟨Nat.pow 2 96, by decide⟩
  | i64 | isize => exact ⟨Nat.pow 2 64, by decide⟩
  | i128 => exact ⟨1, by decide⟩

private theorem nat_mod_mod_of_mul {n a b : Nat} :
    Nat.mod (Nat.mod n (a * b)) a = Nat.mod n a := by
  have hDm : (a * b) * Nat.div n (a * b) + Nat.mod n (a * b) = n :=
    Nat.div_add_mod n (a * b)
  have hEq : n = a * (b * Nat.div n (a * b)) + Nat.mod n (a * b) := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, hDm]
  have h1 : Nat.mod (a * (b * Nat.div n (a * b)) + Nat.mod n (a * b)) a =
      Nat.mod (Nat.mod n (a * b)) a := Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left a _ _
  rw [← hEq] at h1
  exact h1.symm

/-- Unsigned `truncateScalar` never faults and stores the truncated bits. -/
private theorem truncateScalar_unsigned_eq (w : IntWidth) (x : Int) :
    truncateScalar w false x =
      .ok (⟨w, false, truncateBits w (Trusted.MirSemantics.bvOfInt 128 x)⟩,
        truncateBits w (Trusted.MirSemantics.bvOfInt 128 x) !=
          Trusted.MirSemantics.bvOfInt 128 x) :=
  rfl

/-- Truncating a nonnegative integer keeps its low `w.bitWidth` bits. -/
private theorem toNat_truncateBits_mirBvOfInt_ofNat (w : IntWidth) (m : Nat) :
    (truncateBits w (Trusted.MirSemantics.bvOfInt 128 (Int.ofNat m))).toNat =
      Nat.mod m (Nat.pow 2 w.bitWidth) := by
  rw [toNat_truncateBits, intWidthModulus_eq_pow]
  have hB : (Trusted.MirSemantics.bvOfInt 128 (Int.ofNat m)).toNat =
      Nat.mod m (Nat.pow 2 128) := by
    change (BitVec.ofNat 128 (Nat.mod m (Nat.pow 2 128))).toNat = _
    rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
    exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ (nat_two_pow_pos 128))
  rw [hB]
  let ⟨k, hK⟩ := intWidth_pow128_factor w
  rw [hK]
  exact nat_mod_mod_of_mul

/-- Constant-fold a closed `SymScalar` expression. -/
@[expose] noncomputable def SymScalar.asConst? : SymScalar → Option ScalarVal
  | .lit sv => some ⟨sv.width, sv.signed, truncateBitsComp sv.width sv.bits⟩
  | .var _ _ _ => none
  | .unOp op arg =>
    match arg.asConst? with
    | some av =>
      match evalUnOpComp op (.scalar av) with
      | .ok (.scalar sv) => some sv
      | _ => none
    | none => none
  | .binOp op l r =>
    match l.asConst?, r.asConst? with
    | some lv, some rv =>
      match evalBinOpComp op (.scalar lv) (.scalar rv) with
      | .ok (.scalar sv) => some sv
      | _ => none
    | _, _ => none
  | .shift op l r =>
    match l.asConst?, r.asConst? with
    | some lv, some rv =>
      match evalBinOpComp op (.scalar lv) (.scalar rv) with
      | .ok (.scalar sv) => some sv
      | _ => none
    | _, _ => none
  | .cast dstW dstS src =>
    match src.asConst? with
    | some sv =>
      match evalIntToIntCastComp (.scalar sv) (.int dstW dstS) with
      | .ok (.scalar sv') => some sv'
      | _ => none
    | none => none

theorem symScalar_asConst?_sound (env : SymEnv) :
    ∀ (s : SymScalar) (sv : ScalarVal),
      s.asConst? = some sv → s.eval env = sv
  | .lit sv, out, h => by
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval] at h
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval]
    cases h
    rfl
  | .var _ _ _, _, h => by cases h
  | .unOp op arg, out, h => by
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval] at h
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval]
    cases ha : arg.asConst? with
    | none => rw [ha] at h; cases h
    | some av =>
      rw [ha] at h
      dsimp only at h
      rw [symScalar_asConst?_sound env arg av ha]
      cases he : evalUnOpComp op (.scalar av) with
      | error _ => rw [he] at h; cases h
      | ok v =>
        rw [he] at h
        cases v with
        | scalar sv => cases h; rfl
        | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | bool _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit | enumVal _ _
        | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ => cases h
  | .binOp op l r, out, h => by
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval] at h
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval]
    cases hl : l.asConst? with
    | none => rw [hl] at h; cases h
    | some lv =>
      cases hr : r.asConst? with
      | none => rw [hl, hr] at h; cases h
      | some rv =>
        rw [hl, hr] at h
        dsimp only at h
        rw [symScalar_asConst?_sound env l lv hl,
          symScalar_asConst?_sound env r rv hr]
        cases he : evalBinOpComp op (.scalar lv) (.scalar rv) with
        | error _ => rw [he] at h; cases h
        | ok v =>
          rw [he] at h
          cases v with
          | scalar sv => cases h; rfl
          | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | bool _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit | enumVal _ _
          | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ => cases h
  | .shift op l r, out, h => by
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval] at h
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval]
    cases hl : l.asConst? with
    | none => rw [hl] at h; cases h
    | some lv =>
      cases hr : r.asConst? with
      | none => rw [hl, hr] at h; cases h
      | some rv =>
        rw [hl, hr] at h
        dsimp only at h
        rw [symScalar_asConst?_sound env l lv hl,
          symScalar_asConst?_sound env r rv hr]
        cases he : evalBinOpComp op (.scalar lv) (.scalar rv) with
        | error _ => rw [he] at h; cases h
        | ok v =>
          rw [he] at h
          cases v with
          | scalar sv => cases h; rfl
          | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | bool _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit | enumVal _ _
          | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ => cases h
  | .cast dstW dstS src, out, h => by
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval] at h
    dsimp only [SymScalar.asConst?, SymScalar.eval]
    cases hs : src.asConst? with
    | none => rw [hs] at h; cases h
    | some sv =>
      rw [hs] at h
      dsimp only at h
      rw [symScalar_asConst?_sound env src sv hs]
      cases he : evalIntToIntCastComp (.scalar sv) (.int dstW dstS) with
      | error _ => rw [he] at h; cases h
      | ok v =>
        rw [he] at h
        cases v with
        | scalar sv' => cases h; rfl
        | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | bool _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit | enumVal _ _
        | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ => cases h

/-- Compute the symbolic source of bit `i` of `s` (when `0 ≤ i < 128`). -/
@[expose] noncomputable def SymScalar.bitLsb (s : SymScalar) (i : Nat) : Option BitSrc :=
  match s with
  | .lit sv =>
    if Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp sv.width) && Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD sv.bits i then
      some .one
    else
      some .zero
  | .var id w _ =>
    if Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp w) then some (.varBit id i) else some .zero
  | .unOp _ _ => none
  | .binOp .bitAnd l r =>
    if !(intWidthBeqComp l.width r.width && boolBeqComp l.signed r.signed) then none
    else if !Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp l.width) then some .zero
    else
      match SymScalar.bitLsb l i, SymScalar.bitLsb r i with
      | some .zero, _ => some .zero
      | _, some .zero => some .zero
      | some .one, some rb => some rb
      | some lb, some .one => some lb
      | some (.varBit i1 k1), some (.varBit i2 k2) =>
        if Nat.beq i1 i2 && Nat.beq k1 k2 then some (.varBit i1 k1) else none
      | _, _ => none
  | .binOp .bitOr l r =>
    if !(intWidthBeqComp l.width r.width && boolBeqComp l.signed r.signed) then none
    else if !Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp l.width) then some .zero
    else
      match SymScalar.bitLsb l i, SymScalar.bitLsb r i with
      | some .one, _ => some .one
      | _, some .one => some .one
      | some .zero, some rb => some rb
      | some lb, some .zero => some lb
      | some (.varBit i1 k1), some (.varBit i2 k2) =>
        if Nat.beq i1 i2 && Nat.beq k1 k2 then some (.varBit i1 k1) else none
      | _, _ => none
  | .binOp .bitXor l r =>
    if !(intWidthBeqComp l.width r.width && boolBeqComp l.signed r.signed) then none
    else if !Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp l.width) then some .zero
    else
      match SymScalar.bitLsb l i, SymScalar.bitLsb r i with
      | some .zero, some rb => some rb
      | some lb, some .zero => some lb
      | some .one, some .one => some .zero
      | some (.varBit i1 k1), some (.varBit i2 k2) =>
        if Nat.beq i1 i2 && Nat.beq k1 k2 then some .zero else none
      | _, _ => none
  | .binOp _ _ _ => none
  | .shift .shl l r =>
    if l.signed then none
    else
      match r.asConst? with
      | none => none
      | some rsv =>
        let amt := (intEmodComp (decodeScalarComp rsv) (Int.ofNat (bitWidthComp l.width))).toNat
        if Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp l.width) then
          if Nat.blt i amt then some .zero else SymScalar.bitLsb l (i - amt)
        else some .zero
  | .shift .shr l r =>
    if l.signed then none
    else
      match r.asConst? with
      | none => none
      | some rsv =>
        let amt := (intEmodComp (decodeScalarComp rsv) (Int.ofNat (bitWidthComp l.width))).toNat
        if Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp l.width) then
          if Nat.blt (i + amt) (bitWidthComp l.width) then SymScalar.bitLsb l (i + amt) else some .zero
        else some .zero
  | .shift _ _ _ => none
  | .cast dstW _ src =>
    if src.signed then none
    else if Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp dstW) then
      if Nat.blt i (bitWidthComp src.width) then SymScalar.bitLsb src i else some .zero
    else some .zero

private theorem bitSrc_agrees_det {env : SymEnv} {src : BitSrc} {b1 b2 : Bool}
    (h1 : src.Agrees env b1) (h2 : src.Agrees env b2) : b1 = b2 := by
  cases src with
  | zero => exact h1.trans h2.symm
  | one => exact h1.trans h2.symm
  | varBit _ _ => exact h1.trans h2.symm

private theorem bvAndComp_eq (x y : BitVec 128) :
    bvAndComp x y = Anneal.BitVec.and x y := by
  refine bv_eq_of_toNat_eq ?_
  dsimp only [bvAndComp]
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_and]
  exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt (Anneal.NatBitwise.land_lt_two_pow x.isLt y.isLt)

private theorem bvOrComp_eq (x y : BitVec 128) :
    bvOrComp x y = Anneal.BitVec.or x y := by
  refine bv_eq_of_toNat_eq ?_
  dsimp only [bvOrComp]
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_or]
  exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt (Anneal.NatBitwise.lor_lt_two_pow x.isLt y.isLt)

private theorem bvXorComp_eq (x y : BitVec 128) :
    bvXorComp x y = Anneal.BitVec.xor x y := by
  refine bv_eq_of_toNat_eq ?_
  dsimp only [bvXorComp]
  rw [Anneal.BitVec.toNat_ofNat, Anneal.BitVec.toNat_xor]
  exact nat_mod_eq_of_lt (Anneal.NatBitwise.xor_lt_two_pow x.isLt y.isLt)

/-- Soundness of `SymScalar.bitLsb`: if bit `i` (`i < 128`) reduces to
`some src`, then under every `SymEnv` the `i`-th bit of `(s.eval env).bits`
agrees with `src`. -/
theorem symScalar_bitLsb_sound (env : SymEnv) :
    ∀ (s : SymScalar) (i : Nat) (src : BitSrc),
      i < 128 → s.wf = true → s.bitLsb i = some src →
      BitSrc.Agrees env src (Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD (s.eval env).bits i)
  | .lit sv, i, src, hi, _, h => by
    dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb, SymScalar.eval] at h
    dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb, SymScalar.eval]
    rw [natBlt_eq_decide, bitWidthComp_eq] at h
    rw [getLsbD_truncateBitsComp sv.width sv.bits i, decide_eq_true hi, Bool.true_and]
    cases hB : decide (i < sv.width.bitWidth) && Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD sv.bits i with
    | false =>
      rw [hB] at h; cases h; rfl
    | true =>
      rw [hB] at h; cases h; rfl
  | .var id w sg, i, src, hi, _, h => by
    dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb, SymScalar.eval] at h
    dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb, SymScalar.eval]
    rw [natBlt_eq_decide, bitWidthComp_eq] at h
    cases hLt : decide (i < w.bitWidth) with
    | false =>
      rw [hLt] at h; cases h
      dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
      cases env id with
      | scalar sv =>
        rw [getLsbD_truncateBitsComp, decide_eq_true hi, hLt, Bool.false_and, Bool.true_and]
      | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | bool _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit | enumVal _ _
      | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ =>
        exact Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_zero 128 i
    | true =>
      rw [hLt] at h; cases h
      dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
      cases env id with
      | scalar sv =>
        rw [getLsbD_truncateBitsComp, decide_eq_true hi, hLt, Bool.true_and, Bool.true_and]
      | ptr _ | slicePtr _ _ | bool _ | char _ | ordering _ | unit | enumVal _ _
      | tuple _ | bytes _ | rangeTo _ | rangeFrom _ =>
        exact Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_zero 128 i
  | .unOp _ _, _, _, _, _, h => by cases h
  | .binOp op l r, i, src, hi, hWf, h => by
    have hWf1 := bool_and_left hWf
    have hWf2 := bool_and_left hWf1
    have hWf3 := bool_and_left hWf2
    have hWfL := bool_and_left hWf3
    have hWfR := bool_and_right hWf3
    have hL := symScalar_eval_meta env l hWfL
    have hR := symScalar_eval_meta env r hWfR
    have hTrL : truncateBitsComp l.width (l.eval env).bits = (l.eval env).bits := by
      rw [truncateBitsComp_eq, ← hL.1]
      exact beq_iff_eq.mp hL.2.2
    have hTrR : truncateBitsComp r.width (r.eval env).bits = (r.eval env).bits := by
      rw [truncateBitsComp_eq, ← hR.1]
      exact beq_iff_eq.mp hR.2.2
    cases op with
    | bitAnd =>
      dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb] at h
      cases hTy : intWidthBeqComp l.width r.width && boolBeqComp l.signed r.signed with
      | false => rw [hTy] at h; cases h
      | true =>
        rw [hTy] at h
        dsimp only [SymScalar.eval, evalBinOpComp]
        have hNotShift : binOpIsShiftComp .bitAnd = false := rfl
        have hSame : (!(intWidthBeqComp (l.eval env).width (r.eval env).width &&
            boolBeqComp (l.eval env).signed (r.eval env).signed)) = false := by
          rw [hL.1, hR.1, hL.2.1, hR.2.1]
          exact congrArg Bool.not hTy
        rw [natBlt_eq_decide, bitWidthComp_eq] at h
        rw [hNotShift, hSame, ite_false_bool, ite_false_bool]
        dsimp only
        rw [hL.1, hR.1, hTrL, hTrR, bvAndComp_eq,
          getLsbD_truncateBitsComp, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_and, decide_eq_true hi,
          Bool.true_and]
        cases hLt : decide (i < l.width.bitWidth) with
        | false =>
          rw [hLt] at h; cases h; rfl
        | true =>
          rw [hLt, bnot_true, ite_false_bool, ite_false_bool] at h
          rw [Bool.true_and]
          cases hLb : l.bitLsb i with
          | none =>
            rw [hLb] at h
            cases hRb : r.bitLsb i with
            | none => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
            | some rb =>
              cases rb with
              | zero =>
                rw [hRb] at h; cases h
                have hAg := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i .zero hi hWfR hRb
                dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAg
                dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                rw [hAg, Bool.and_false]
              | one | varBit _ _ => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
          | some lb =>
            cases lb with
            | zero =>
              rw [hLb] at h; cases h
              have hAg := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env l i .zero hi hWfL hLb
              dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAg
              dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
              rw [hAg, Bool.false_and]
            | one =>
              rw [hLb] at h
              have hAgL := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env l i .one hi hWfL hLb
              dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgL
              rw [hAgL, Bool.true_and]
              cases hRb : r.bitLsb i with
              | none => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
              | some rb =>
                rw [hRb] at h
                cases rb with
                | zero => cases h; exact (symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i .zero hi hWfR hRb)
                | one => cases h; exact (symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i .one hi hWfR hRb)

            | varBit id1 k1 =>

              have hAgL := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env l i (.varBit id1 k1) hi hWfL hLb
              cases hRb : r.bitLsb i with
              | none => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
              | some rb =>
                rw [hRb] at h
                have hAgR := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i rb hi hWfR hRb
                cases rb with
                | zero =>
                  cases h
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgR
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                  rw [hAgR, Bool.and_false]
                | one =>

                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgR
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                  rw [hAgR, Bool.and_true]

                  | false => rw [hEq] at h; cases h
                  | true =>

                    have hi12 := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_left hEq)
                    have hk12 := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_right hEq)
                    rw [← hi12, ← hk12] at hAgR
                    have hSameB := bitSrc_agrees_det hAgL hAgR
                    rw [← hSameB, Bool.and_self]

    | bitOr =>
      dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb] at h

      | true =>

        dsimp only [SymScalar.eval, evalBinOpComp]
        have hNotShift : binOpIsShiftComp .bitOr = false := rfl

          exact congrArg Bool.not hTy
        rw [natBlt_eq_decide, bitWidthComp_eq] at h
        rw [hNotShift, hSame, ite_false_bool, ite_false_bool]
        dsimp only
        rw [hL.1, hR.1, hTrL, hTrR, bvOrComp_eq,
          getLsbD_truncateBitsComp, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_or, decide_eq_true hi,
          Bool.true_and]
        cases hLt : decide (i < l.width.bitWidth) with
        | false => rw [hLt] at h; cases h; rfl
        | true =>
          rw [hLt, bnot_true, ite_false_bool, ite_false_bool] at h
          rw [Bool.true_and]
          cases hLb : l.bitLsb i with
          | none =>
            rw [hLb] at h
            cases hRb : r.bitLsb i with
            | none => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
            | some rb =>

              | one =>
                rw [hRb] at h; cases h
                have hAg := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i .one hi hWfR hRb
                dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAg
                dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                rw [hAg, Bool.or_true]
              | zero | varBit _ _ => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
          | some lb =>
            cases lb with
            | one =>
              rw [hLb] at h; cases h
              have hAg := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env l i .one hi hWfL hLb
              dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAg
              dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
              rw [hAg, Bool.true_or]
            | zero =>

              dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgL
              rw [hAgL, Bool.false_or]
              cases hRb : r.bitLsb i with
              | none => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
              | some rb =>

                cases rb with
                | zero => cases h; exact (symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i .zero hi hWfR hRb)
                | one => cases h; exact (symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i .one hi hWfR hRb)
                | varBit id2 k2 =>
                  cases h
                  exact symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i (.varBit id2 k2) hi hWfR hRb
            | varBit id1 k1 =>
              rw [hLb] at h
              have hAgL := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env l i (.varBit id1 k1) hi hWfL hLb
              cases hRb : r.bitLsb i with
              | none => rw [hRb] at h; cases h
              | some rb =>
                rw [hRb] at h
                have hAgR := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i rb hi hWfR hRb
                cases rb with
                | one =>
                  cases h
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgR
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                  rw [hAgR, Bool.or_true]
                | zero =>
                  cases h
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgR
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                  rw [hAgR, Bool.or_false]
                  exact hAgL
                | varBit id2 k2 =>
                  dsimp only at h
                  cases hEq : Nat.beq id1 id2 && Nat.beq k1 k2 with
                  | false => rw [hEq] at h; cases h
                  | true =>
                    rw [hEq] at h; cases h
                    have hi12 := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_left hEq)
                    have hk12 := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_right hEq)
                    rw [← hi12, ← hk12] at hAgR
                    have hSameB := bitSrc_agrees_det hAgL hAgR
                    rw [← hSameB, Bool.or_self]
                    exact hAgL
    | bitXor =>
      dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb] at h
      cases hTy : intWidthBeqComp l.width r.width && boolBeqComp l.signed r.signed with
      | false => rw [hTy] at h; cases h
      | true =>
        rw [hTy] at h
        dsimp only [SymScalar.eval, evalBinOpComp]
        have hNotShift : binOpIsShiftComp .bitXor = false := rfl
        have hSame : (!(intWidthBeqComp (l.eval env).width (r.eval env).width &&
            boolBeqComp (l.eval env).signed (r.eval env).signed)) = false := by
          rw [hL.1, hR.1, hL.2.1, hR.2.1]
          exact congrArg Bool.not hTy
        rw [natBlt_eq_decide, bitWidthComp_eq] at h
        rw [hNotShift, hSame, ite_false_bool, ite_false_bool]
        dsimp only
        rw [hL.1, hR.1, hTrL, hTrR, bvXorComp_eq,
          getLsbD_truncateBitsComp, Anneal.BitVec.getLsbD_xor, decide_eq_true hi,
          Bool.true_and]
        cases hLt : decide (i < l.width.bitWidth) with
        | false => rw [hLt] at h; cases h; rfl
        | true =>
          rw [hLt, bnot_true, ite_false_bool, ite_false_bool] at h
          rw [Bool.true_and]
          cases hLb : l.bitLsb i with
          | none => rw [hLb] at h; cases h
          | some lb =>
            cases hRb : r.bitLsb i with
            | none => rw [hLb, hRb] at h; cases lb <;> cases h
            | some rb =>
              rw [hLb, hRb] at h
              have hAgL := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env l i lb hi hWfL hLb
              have hAgR := symScalar_bitLsb_sound env r i rb hi hWfR hRb
              cases lb with
              | zero =>
                cases h
                dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgL
                rw [hAgL, bool_false_bne]
                exact hAgR
              | one =>
                cases rb with
                | zero =>
                  cases h
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgR
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                  rw [hAgR, bool_bne_false]
                  exact hAgL
                | one =>
                  cases h
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgL hAgR
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                  rw [hAgL, hAgR]
                  rfl
                | varBit _ _ => cases h
              | varBit id1 k1 =>
                cases rb with
                | zero =>
                  cases h
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees] at hAgR
                  dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                  rw [hAgR, bool_bne_false]
                  exact hAgL
                | one => cases h
                | varBit id2 k2 =>
                  dsimp only at h
                  cases hEq : Nat.beq id1 id2 && Nat.beq k1 k2 with
                  | false => rw [hEq] at h; cases h
                  | true =>
                    rw [hEq] at h; cases h
                    have hi12 := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_left hEq)
                    have hk12 := nat_eq_of_beq (bool_and_right hEq)
                    rw [← hi12, ← hk12] at hAgR
                    have hSameB := bitSrc_agrees_det hAgL hAgR
                    dsimp only [BitSrc.Agrees]
                    rw [← hSameB, bool_bne_self]
    | add | sub | mul | div | rem
    | addUnchecked | subUnchecked | mulUnchecked
    | addWithOverflow | subWithOverflow | mulWithOverflow
    | shl | shr | shlUnchecked | shrUnchecked
    | eq | lt | le | ne | ge | gt | cmp | offset => cases h
  | .shift op l r, i, src, hi, hWf, h => by
    have hWf1 := bool_and_left hWf
    have hWfL := bool_and_left hWf1
    have hL := symScalar_eval_meta env l hWfL
    have hTrL : truncateBitsComp (l.eval env).width (l.eval env).bits =
        (l.eval env).bits := by
      rw [truncateBitsComp_eq]
      exact beq_iff_eq.mp hL.2.2
    have hBitsLt : (l.eval env).bits.toNat < Nat.pow 2 l.width.bitWidth := by
      rw [← hTrL, truncateBitsComp_eq, toNat_truncateBits, intWidthModulus_eq_pow, hL.1]
      exact Nat.mod_lt _ (nat_two_pow_pos l.width.bitWidth)
    cases op with
    | shl =>
      dsimp only [SymScalar.bitLsb] at h
      cases hSig : l.signed with
      | true => rw [hSig] at h; cases h
      | false =>
        rw [hSig] at h
        cases hr : r.asConst? with
        | none => rw [hr] at h; cases h
        | some rsv =>
          rw [hr, natBlt_eq_decide, bitWidthComp_eq] at h
          dsimp only at h
          have hRConst := symScalar_asConst?_sound env r rsv hr
          have hLSig : (l.eval env).signed = false := hL.2.1.trans hSig
          let amt := (intEmodComp (decodeScalarComp rsv) (Int.ofNat l.width.bitWidth)).toNat
          have hDecL : decodeScalar (l.eval env) = Int.ofNat (l.eval env).bits.toNat := by

            rw [hLSig, ← truncateBitsComp_eq, hTrL]
            rfl
